ex.en: This case emphasizes / highlights the importance of honest communication between managers and employees.
ex.cn: 这个事例凸显出经理与员工之间坦诚交流的重要性。

ex.en: Effective communication skills are essential / crucial / vital.
ex.cn: 有效的交流技巧是至关重要的。

ex.en: It should be noted that this study considers only verbal communication. Non-verbal communication is not dealt with here.
ex.cn: 应该注意的是本研究只考查了言语交流，在此没有涉及非言语交流。

ex.en: It is important to remember that / An important point to remember is that non-verbal communication plays a key role in getting your message across.
ex.cn: 非言语交流在传递信息过程中起着重要的作用，记住这一点非常重要。

ex.en: Communication is not only about the words you use but also your body language and, especially / above all, the effectiveness with which you listen.
ex.cn: 交流不仅涉及使用的词语，同时也涉及身体语言，尤其与能否有效听取对方的话有关。

senses.def: special or specific

ex.en: Peter was lying on the sofa doing nothing in particular.
ex.cn: 彼得躺在沙发上，无所事事。

ex.en: Is there anything in particular you'd like for dinner?
ex.cn: 晚饭你有具体想吃的吗？

ex.en: She directed the question at no one in particular.
ex.cn: 她的问题并没有针对任何个人。

senses.def: a fact or detail, especially one that is officially written down

ex.en: The police officer took down all the particulars of the burglary.
ex.cn: 这名警察记下了窃案发生的详细情况。

ex.en: The nurse asked me for my particulars (= personal details such as your name, address, etc.).
ex.cn: 护士向我询问了我的个人资料。

ex.en: The new contract will be the same in every particular as the old one.
ex.cn: 新合同与旧合同的各项细节将完全相同。

senses.def: written information and details about a property, business, job, etc.
senses.chn: 详细资料；详细介绍材料

ex.en: Application forms and further particulars are available from the Personnel Office.
ex.cn: 申请表格及其他详细资料可向人事部索取。

senses.def: the quality of being individual or unique

ex.en: the particularity of each human being
ex.cn: 每个人的独特性

senses.def: attention to detail; being exact
the special features or details of sth
to give details of sth, especially one by one; to give particular examples of sth
senses.chn: 详细说明；逐一列举；以具体的例子说明

senses.def: especially; more than usual or more than others

ex.en: particularly good/important/useful
ex.cn: 特别好／重要／有用

ex.en: Traffic is bad, particularly in the city centre.
ex.cn: 交通状况很差，尤其是在市中心。

ex.en: I enjoyed the play, particularly the second half.
ex.cn: 我很喜欢那部剧，特别是下半段。

ex.en: The lecture was not particularly (= not very) interesting.
ex.cn: 讲座并不特别精彩。

ex.en: 'Did you enjoy it?' 'No, not particularly (= not very much).'
ex.cn: “你玩得开心吗？” “不很开心。”

senses.def: relating to, or in the form of, particles

ex.en: particulate pollution
ex.cn: 颗粒污染物

senses.def: matter in the form of particles
the act or occasion of leaving a person or place

ex.en: the moment of parting
ex.cn: 离别的时刻

ex.en: We had a tearful parting at the airport.
ex.cn: 我们在机场洒泪而别。

senses.def: a line on a person's head where the hair is divided with a comb

ex.en: a side/centre parting
ex.cn: 偏分；中分

senses.def: the act or result of dividing sth into parts

ex.en: the parting of the clouds
ex.cn: 云破天开

senses.def: a point at which two people or groups of people decide to separate
senses.chn: 岔路口；分道扬镳处；分手处

senses.def: said or done by sb as they leave

ex.en: a parting kiss
ex.cn: 临别之吻

ex.en: His parting words were 'I love you.'
ex.cn: 他临别的话是 “我爱你”。

senses.def: a final remark, especially an unkind one, that sb makes as they leave
senses.chn: 临去的放话（尤指不友善的）

senses.def: a final remark, especially an unkind one, that sb makes as they leave
senses.chn: 临去的放话（尤指不友善的）

senses.def: showing too much support for one person, group or idea, especially without considering it carefully
senses.chn: （对个别人、团体或思想）过分支持的，偏护的，盲目拥护的

ex.en: Most newspapers are politically partisan.
ex.cn: 大多数报纸都有政治倾向。

senses.def: a person who strongly supports a particular leader, group or idea
senses.chn: 坚定的支持者；铁杆拥护者

senses.def: a member of an armed group that is fighting secretly against enemy soldiers who have taken control of its country
a wall or screen that separates one part of a room from another

ex.en: a glass partition
ex.cn: 玻璃隔板

ex.en: partition walls
ex.cn: 隔断墙

senses.def: the division of one country into two or more countries

ex.en: the partition of Germany after the war
ex.cn: 战后对德国的分割

senses.def: to divide sth into parts

ex.en: to partition a country
ex.cn: 分割一个国家

ex.en: The room is partitioned into three sections.
ex.cn: 这间屋子被隔为三小间。

senses.def: to separate one area, one part of a room, etc. from another with a wall or screen

example.en: to partition a country
example.cn: 分割一个国家

example.en: The room is partitioned into three sections.
example.cn: 这间屋子被隔为三小间。

senses.def: a word or phrase that shows a part or quantity of sth
senses.chn: 表示部分的词（或词组）；表量词语

ex.en: In 'a spoonful of sugar', the word 'spoonful' is a partitive.
ex.cn: 在 a spoonful of sugar 中，spoonful 一词是表量词。

senses.def: to some extent; not completely

ex.en: Some people are unwilling to attend the classes partly because of the cost involved.
ex.cn: 有些人不愿来上课，部分原因是所需的费用问题。

ex.en: He was only partly responsible for the accident.
ex.cn: 他对这次事故只负有部分责任。

ex.en: The road is partly/partially finished.
ex.cn: 道路完工了一部分。

ex.en: I didn't enjoy the trip very much, partly because of the weather.
ex.cn: 我旅行过得不太愉快，部分是因为天气的缘故。

ex.en: His mother is partially blind.
ex.cn: 他的母亲失去了部分视力。

senses.def: the person that you are married to or having a sexual relationship with

ex.en: Come to the New Year disco and bring your partner!
ex.cn: 携伴来参加新年迪斯科舞会吧！

ex.en: a marriage partner
ex.cn: 配偶

senses.def: one of the people who owns a business and shares the profits, etc.

ex.en: a partner in a law firm
ex.cn: 律师事务所的合伙人

ex.en: a junior/senior partner
ex.cn: 次要／主要合伙人

senses.def: a person that you are doing an activity with, such as dancing or playing a game

ex.en: a dancing/tennis, etc. partner
ex.cn: 舞伴、网球搭档等

senses.def: a country or an organization that has an agreement with another country
senses.chn: 伙伴（与另一国家有协议关系的国家或组织）

ex.en: a trading partner
ex.cn: 贸易伙伴

senses.def: to be sb's partner in a dance, game, etc.
senses.chn: （在跳舞、游戏等中）结成伙伴，做搭档，配对

ex.en: Gerry offered to partner me at tennis.
ex.cn: 格里提出和我搭档打网球。

senses.def: the state of being a partner in business

ex.en: to be in/to go into partnership
ex.cn: 结成合作关系

ex.en: He developed his own program in partnership with an American expert.
ex.cn: 他与一位美国专家合作开发出自己的程序。

senses.def: a relationship between two people, organizations, etc.; the state of having this relationship

ex.en: Marriage should be an equal partnership.
ex.cn: 婚姻应当是平等的伴侣关系。

ex.en: the school's partnership with parents
ex.cn: 学校与家长的合作

ex.en: a partnership between the United States and Europe
ex.cn: 美国与欧洲的合作

senses.def: a business owned by two or more people who share the profits

ex.en: a junior member of the partnership
ex.cn: 企业的次要合伙人

example.en: He developed his own program in partnership with an American expert.
example.cn: 他与一位美国专家合作开发出自己的程序。

example.en: a partnership between the United States and Europe
example.cn: 美国与欧洲的合作

senses.def: one of the classes into which words are divided according to their grammar, such as noun, verb, adjective, etc.
a person or thing that you are so used to seeing that you no longer notice them
senses.chn: 见惯了的人（或东西）；存在已久故不为人注意的人（或事物）

ex.en: I worked there so long that I became part of the furniture.
ex.cn: 我在那里工作得太久，都不为人注意了。

senses.def: a brown bird with a round body and a short tail, that people hunt for sport or food; the meat of this bird
for part of the day or week in which people work

ex.en: She's looking for a part-time job.
ex.cn: 她在寻找兼职工作。

ex.en: to study on a part-time basis
ex.cn: 在职学习

ex.en: part-time workers
ex.cn: 兼职工作者

ex.en: I'm only part-time at the moment.
ex.cn: 我现在只是兼职。

ex.en: Liz works part-time from 10 till 2.
ex.cn: 利兹的兼职时间是 10 点到 2 点。

senses.def: a person who works part-time
senses.chn: 兼职者；部分时间工作的人

senses.def: the act of giving birth
some of the way

ex.en: They were part-way through the speeches when he arrived.
ex.cn: 他到达的时候讲演已经进行一段时间了。

senses.def: to give sth to sb else, especially sth that you would prefer to keep
senses.chn: 放弃，交出（尤指不舍得的东西）

ex.en: Make sure you read the contract before parting with any money.
ex.cn: 一定要注意先看清合约再交钱。

senses.def: a book that is published in several parts that people can collect over a period of time
senses.chn: 分期发表的作品；分册出版的书

senses.def: a political organization that you can vote for in elections and whose members have the same aims and ideas

ex.en: the Democratic and Republican Parties in the United States
ex.cn: 美国的民主党和共和党

ex.en: She belongs to the Labour Party.
ex.cn: 她是工党党员。

ex.en: the ruling/opposition party
ex.cn: 执政党；反对党

ex.en: the party leader/manifesto/policy
ex.cn: 党的领袖／宣言／政策

senses.def: a social occasion, often in a person's home, at which people eat, drink, talk, dance and enjoy themselves

ex.en: a birthday/dinner/garden, etc. party
ex.cn: 生日聚会、晚宴、园会等

ex.en: to give/have/throw a party
ex.cn: 搞聚会

ex.en: Did you go to the party?
ex.cn: 你去参加聚会了吗？

ex.en: party games
ex.cn: 联欢会游戏

senses.def: a group of people who are doing sth together such as travelling or visiting somewhere
senses.chn: （一起旅行或参观等的）群，队，组

ex.en: The school is taking a party of 40 children to France.
ex.cn: 学校将带领一个 40 人的儿童团队前往法国。

ex.en: The theatre gives a 10% discount to parties of more than ten.
ex.cn: 剧场给十人以上的团体打九折。

senses.def: one of the people or groups of people involved in a legal agreement or argument

ex.en: the guilty/innocent party
ex.cn: 有罪的／无罪的一方

ex.en: The contract can be terminated by either party with three months' notice.
ex.cn: 合同的任何一方如提前三个月通知，均可终止本合同。

senses.def: to be involved in an agreement or action

ex.en: to be party to a decision
ex.cn: 参与作出决议

ex.en: He refused to be a party to any violence.
ex.cn: 他拒绝参与任何暴力活动。

senses.def: to contribute sth useful to a discussion, project, etc.
senses.chn: 为（讨论、项目等）作出贡献

ex.en: What Hislop brought to the party was real commitment and energy.
ex.cn: 希斯洛普对党的贡献是他全身心的投入和十足的干劲。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself, especially by eating, drinking alcohol and dancing

ex.en: They were out partying every night.
ex.cn: 他们每晚都外出寻欢作乐。

senses.def: small gifts that are often given to children at a party
a person who enjoys going to parties or who is a guest at a particular party
senses.chn: 爱参加聚会的人；聚会的客人

senses.def: the official opinions and policies of a political party, which members are expected to support

ex.en: to toe the party line
ex.cn: 遵循党的路线

senses.def: a thing that sb does to entertain people, especially at parties, for example singing a song
made by or relating to a political party

ex.en: a party political broadcast
ex.cn: 党派政治广播

senses.def: political activity that involves political parties

ex.en: The President should stand above party politics.
ex.cn: 总统应当置身于政党政治之上。

ex.en: Many people think that party politics should not enter into local government.
ex.cn: 许多人都认为，地方政府内不应拉帮结派。

senses.def: a person who does not want to take part in an enjoyable activity and spoils the fun for other people
the sort of mood in which you can enjoy a party and have fun
senses.chn: 社交情结；爱社交的心情

senses.def: a wall that divides two buildings or rooms and belongs to both owners
a person from a low social or economic position who has suddenly become rich or powerful
the standard unit for measuring pressure
a language used for writing programs for computer systems
senses.chn: 帕斯卡语言；Pascal（计算机系统编程）语言

senses.def: relating to Easter
relating to the Jewish Passover
a dance, often part of a ballet, that is performed by two people
a long piece of cloth made of fine soft wool from a type of goat and worn by a woman around the shoulders
the official language of Afghanistan, also spoken in northern Pakistan
senses.chn: 普什图语（阿富汗官方语言，也用于巴基斯坦北部地区）

senses.def: to move past or to the other side of sb/sth

ex.en: Several people were passing but nobody offered to help.
ex.cn: 有几个人路过，却没有人主动伸出援手。

ex.en: I hailed a passing taxi.
ex.cn: 我招手叫了一辆路过的出租车。

ex.en: The road was so narrow that cars were unable to pass.
ex.cn: 道路太窄，汽车无法通过。

ex.en: to pass a barrier/sentry/checkpoint
ex.cn: 通过障碍／岗哨／检查站

ex.en: You'll pass a bank on the way to the train station.
ex.cn: 你在去火车站的路上会经过一家银行。

ex.en: She passed me in the street without even saying hello.
ex.cn: 她在街上与我擦肩而过，却连一声招呼也没打。

senses.def: to go or move in the direction mentioned
senses.chn: 沿某方向前进；向某方向移动

ex.en: The procession passed slowly along the street.
ex.cn: 队伍沿街缓缓行进。

ex.en: A plane passed low overhead.
ex.cn: 一架飞机从头上低空飞过。

senses.def: to make sth move in the direction or into the position mentioned
senses.chn: 使沿（某方向）移动；使达到（某位置）

ex.en: He passed the rope around the post three times to secure it.
ex.cn: 他把绳索在柱子上绕了三匝缠紧。

senses.def: to give sth to sb by putting it into their hands or in a place where they can easily reach it

ex.en: Pass the salt, please.
ex.cn: 请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Pass that book over.
ex.cn: 把那本书递过来。

ex.en: Pass me over that book.
ex.cn: 递给我那本书。

senses.def: to kick, hit or throw the ball to a player of your own side

ex.en: He passed the ball to Rooney.
ex.cn: 他把球传给了鲁尼。

ex.en: Why do they keep passing back to the goalie?
ex.cn: 他们为什么老是把球回传给守门员？

senses.def: to be given to another person after first belonging to sb else, especially after the first person has died
senses.chn: 转移给，遗留给（继承人等）

ex.en: On his death, the title passed to his eldest son.
ex.cn: 他死后，封号传给长子。

senses.def: to become greater than a particular total

ex.en: Unemployment has now passed the three million mark.
ex.cn: 失业人数现已突破三百万大关。

senses.def: to change from one state or condition to another

ex.en: She had passed from childhood to early womanhood.
ex.cn: 她已由童年进入了少女期。

senses.def: when time passes, it goes by

ex.en: Six months passed and we still had no news of them.
ex.cn: 半年过去了，我们仍然没有他们的音讯。

ex.en: We grew more anxious with every passing day.
ex.cn: 一天天过去，我们的焦虑与日俱增。

senses.def: to spend time, especially when you are bored or waiting for sth

ex.en: We sang songs to pass the time.
ex.cn: 我们借唱歌消磨时间。

ex.en: How did you pass the evening?
ex.cn: 你是怎么打发那个晚上的？

senses.def: to come to an end; to be over

ex.en: They waited for the storm to pass.
ex.cn: 他们等待暴风雨过去。

senses.def: to achieve the required standard in an exam, a test, etc.

ex.en: I'm not really expecting to pass first time.
ex.cn: 我真不指望第一次就能合格。

ex.en: She hasn't passed her driving test yet.
ex.cn: 她还没有通过驾驶执照考试。

senses.def: to test sb and decide that they are good enough, according to an agreed standard

ex.en: The examiners passed all the candidates.
ex.cn: 主考人评定考生全部及格。

senses.def: to accept a proposal, law, etc. by voting
senses.chn: 经表决通过（动议、法律等）

ex.en: The bill was passed by 360 votes to 280.
ex.cn: 这个法案以 360 票对 280 票获得通过。

senses.def: to be allowed

ex.en: I don't like it, but I'll let it pass (= will not object).
ex.cn: 我不喜欢，但我也不会反对。

ex.en: Her remarks passed without comment (= people ignored them).
ex.cn: 人们对她的言论未予理睬。

senses.def: to happen; to be said or done

ex.en: They'll never be friends again after all that has passed between them.
ex.cn: 经过了这么多事情，他们已经友谊难再了。

ex.en: His departure passed unnoticed.
ex.cn: 他神不知、鬼不觉地离开了。

senses.def: to say that you do not know the answer to a question, especially during a quiz
senses.chn: 不知道，过（尤在回答竞赛问题时所用）

ex.en: 'What's the capital of Peru?' 'I'll have to pass on that one.'
ex.cn: “秘鲁的首都是哪里？” “过。”

ex.en: 'Who wrote 'Catch-22'?' 'Pass (= I don't know).'
ex.cn: “谁写了《第二十二条军规》？” “不知道。”

senses.def: to say that you do not want sth that is offered to you

ex.en: Thanks. I'm going to pass on dessert, if you don't mind.
ex.cn: 谢谢，您若不介意，我就免了饭后甜点吧。

senses.def: to say or state sth, especially officially

ex.en: The court waited in silence for the judge to pass sentence.
ex.cn: 全体出庭人员默默等待法官宣判。

ex.en: It's not for me to pass judgement on your behaviour.
ex.cn: 我无权评判你的行为。

ex.en: The man smiled at the girl and passed a friendly remark.
ex.cn: 男子对姑娘微微一笑，又说了句亲切的话。

senses.def: to go beyond the limits of what you can believe, understand, etc.

ex.en: It passes belief (= is impossible to believe) that she could do such a thing.
ex.cn: 很难相信她会做出这等事来。

senses.def: to refuse to play a card or make a bid1 (4) when it is your turn
to send sth out from the body as or with waste matter

ex.en: If you're passing blood you ought to see a doctor.
ex.cn: 如果便中带血，你就应该找大夫看看。

senses.def: to happen
if words do not pass your lips, you say nothing
if food or drink does not pass your lips, you eat or drink nothing
to collect money from a number of people, for example to buy a present for sb
to be accepted as of a good enough standard
to say hello to sb and have a short conversation with them
senses.chn: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿

senses.def: to urinate
to give sth to another person, who gives it to sb else, etc. until everyone has seen it

ex.en: Can you pass these pictures around for everyone to look at, please?
ex.cn: 请你把这些画传给每个人看一看好吗？

senses.def: to die. People say 'pass away' to avoid saying 'die'.

ex.en: His mother passed away last year.
ex.cn: 他母亲去年去世了。

senses.def: to stop existing

ex.en: civilizations that have passed away
ex.cn: 不复存在的文明

senses.def: to go past

ex.en: The procession passed right by my front door.
ex.cn: 队伍正好从我家前门经过。

senses.def: to happen without affecting sb/sth

ex.en: She feels that life is passing her by (= that she is not enjoying the opportunities and pleasures of life).
ex.cn: 她觉得人生毫不眷顾她。

senses.def: to give or teach sth to your children or people younger than you, who will then give or teach it to those who live after them, and so on
to be accepted as sb/sth

ex.en: He speaks the language so well he could easily pass for a German.
ex.cn: 他德语讲得好极了，很容易被当成德国人。

ex.en: We had some wine—or what passes for wine in that area.
ex.cn: 我们喝了一些酒，或是在那个地区被当作酒的东西。

senses.def: to become a part of sth
senses.chn: 变为其中一部分；融入；纳入

ex.en: Many foreign words have passed into the English language.
ex.cn: 许多外来词语已变成英语的一部分。

senses.def: to take place and be completed in a particular way

ex.en: The demonstration passed off peacefully.
ex.cn: 示威游行始终和平地进行。

senses.def: to pretend that sb/sth is sth they are not

ex.en: He escaped by passing himself off as a guard.
ex.cn: 他伪装成看守人而得以脱逃。

senses.def: to give sth to sb else, especially after receiving it or using it yourself

ex.en: Pass the book on to me when you've finished with it.
ex.cn: 你看完那本书后请传给我。

ex.en: I passed your message on to my mother.
ex.cn: 我把你的留言转给我妈了。

ex.en: Much of the discount is pocketed by retailers instead of being passed on to customers.
ex.cn: 折扣的大部分进了零售商的腰包，而顾客没有得到实惠。

senses.def: to become unconscious

ex.cn: 他们决定不计较她的粗鲁言辞。

ex.cn: 我们路过此地，所以想来问候一声。

ex.cn: 真想不到居然拒绝这样的好意！

ex.cn: 第一步，所有地址均输入数据库。

example.cn: 通过障碍／岗哨／检查站

example.cn: 请把盐递过来。

example.en: Pass me over that book.
example.cn: 递给我那本书。

example.en: Why do they keep passing back to the goalie?
example.cn: 他们为什么老是把球回传给守门员？

example.en: They'll never be friends again after all that has passed between them.
example.cn: 经过了这么多事情，他们已经友谊难再了。

example.en: His departure passed unnoticed.
example.cn: 他神不知、鬼不觉地离开了。

senses.def: fairly good but not excellent

in a way that is acceptable or good enough

ex.cn: 他法语讲得还可以。

ex.cn: 地下秘密通道

ex.cn: 一条阴暗狭窄的走廊通向大厅。

ex.cn: 阅读下面这段文章并回答后面的问题。

ex.en: Her confidence grew with the passage of time.
ex.cn: 她的信心与日俱增。

ex.en: The bill is now guaranteed an easy passage through the House of Representatives.
ex.cn: 现在该法案保证能在众议院顺利通过。

ex.cn: 她的祖父一路在船上打工支付船费来到美国。

ex.cn: 警察在人群中辟开一条通路。

ex.cn: 大树可能阻挡光线穿过。

ex.cn: 我们得到保证，可以安全通过占领区。

ex.cn: 他母亲去年去世了。

senses.def: to stop existing

ex.cn: 不复存在的文明

ex.cn: 公司养不起白吃饭的人。

senses.chn: （汽车驾驶员旁边的）乘客座位；副驾驶座

ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
ex.cn: 据目击者说，飞机起飞后不久就爆炸了。

ex.cn: 在撞车地点聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police asked passers-by if they had witnessed the accident.
ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

ex.cn: 三名无辜的旁观者在交火中丧生。

the fact of sth ending or of sb dying
senses.chn: （事物的）结束，消亡；（人的）亡故，逝世

ex.cn: 当政府最终垮台，将不会有人为它的消亡而悲哀。

ex.cn: 很多人将会为她的过世而悲伤。

ex.cn: 决议／法律的通过

ex.cn: 他只是随口提及而已，并没有谈任何细节。

ex.cn: 过渡阶段；一闪念；一时之兴

ex.cn: 他在书中对这个理论只是一笔带过。

ex.cn: 随着时间的流逝，我越发爱他了。

ex.cn: 过往车辆的嘈杂

senses.chn: （高速公路等靠近路中央的）超车车道，快车道

senses.chn: 超身球，穿越球（越过对手使其无法接住）

ex.cn: 他是个性情暴烈的人。

ex.cn: 激情犯罪

ex.cn: 她相当激动地为自己的主张提出论据。

ex.cn: 会上群情激愤。

ex.cn: 哪怕是有人提到他的名字，她也会勃然大怒。

senses.chn: 强烈的爱（尤指两性间的）

ex.cn: 他迷恋她，达到了不顾一切的地步。

senses.chn: 酷爱；热衷的爱好（或活动等）

ex.cn: 英格兰人酷爱花园。

ex.cn: 他对音乐情有独钟。

having or showing strong feelings of sexual love or of anger, etc.
senses.chn: 拥有（或表现出）强烈性爱的；情意绵绵的；怒不可遏的

ex.cn: 天性易激动

ex.cn: 对音乐的浓厚兴趣

ex.cn: 公民自由权利的积极捍卫者

senses.chn: 鸡蛋果，百香果（一种西番莲果实）

a play about the suffering and death of Jesus Christ
accepting what happens or what people do without trying to change anything or oppose them

ex.cn: 他在他们的关系中处于被动地位。

ex.en: a passive observer of events
ex.cn: 列席观察员

the form of a verb used when the subject is affected by the action of the verb
senses.chn: 动词被动形式；被动语态

ex.en: He exhibited passive-aggressive tendencies.
ex.cn: 他表现出了消极抵抗倾向。

senses.def: a way of opposing a government or an enemy by peaceful means, often by refusing to obey laws or orders
the act of breathing in smoke from other people's cigarettes
the state of accepting what happens without reacting or trying to fight against it
to put a verb into the passive form
senses.chn: 将（动词）变成被动语态形式；使被动化

senses.def: to be accepted as of a good enough standard
to take place and be completed in a particular way

ex.cn: 示威游行始终和平地进行。

senses.def: to become unconscious
the Jewish religious festival and holiday in memory of the escape of the Jews from Egypt
senses.chn: 逾越节（犹太人的宗教节日）

senses.def: to ignore or avoid sth

ex.en: They chose to pass over her rude remarks.
ex.cn: 他们决定不计较她的粗鲁言辞。

senses.def: an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country, and that you may have to show when you enter or leave a country

ex.en: a valid passport
ex.cn: 有效护照

ex.en: a South African passport
ex.cn: 南非护照

ex.en: I was stopped as I went through passport control (= where passports are checked).
ex.cn: 在经过护照查验卡时，我被叫住了。

ex.en: a passport photo
ex.cn: 护照相片

ex.cn: 获得成功的唯一途径就是艰苦奋斗。

a series of letters or numbers that you must type into a computer or computer system in order to be able to use it

ex.en: Enter a username and password to get into the system.
ex.cn: 进入系统请键入用户名和密码。

ex.cn: 在过去的岁月／世纪／时代

ex.en: in times past
ex.cn: 在过去

ex.cn: 讨论的时间已过。

ex.cn: 近几周来我很少见到她。

ex.en: The past month has been really busy at work.
ex.cn: 上个月工作实在是忙。

ex.cn: 以往的事件

ex.cn: 根据过去的经验，我想他可能把时间忘了。

ex.en: past and present students of the college
ex.cn: 学院的老校友和在校生

ex.cn: 咱们且忘掉更该责怪谁吧，那都是陈年旧账了。

ex.cn: 过去我常去那里。

ex.en: the recent/distant past
ex.cn: 较近的／遥远的过去

ex.cn: 她回首往事毫无遗憾。

ex.cn: 写信好像已是昔日的事情了。

ex.cn: 我们对他的过去一无所知。

ex.cn: 据说她有一段 “过去”（不名誉的秘史）。

senses.chn: （现在又看见、听到、遇到等的）故人，往事，旧物

ex.cn: 很久以前的故事

senses.def: to behave as though society, etc. has not changed, when in fact it has
later than sth

ex.en: half past two
ex.cn: 两点半

ex.en: ten (minutes) past six
ex.cn: 六点过十分

ex.en: There's a bus at twenty minutes past the hour (= at 1.20, 2.20, etc.).
ex.cn: 每小时逢二十分发一班公共汽车。

ex.cn: 我们两点钟到达，十分钟后离开。

ex.en: It was past midnight when we got home.
ex.cn: 我们到家已是午夜之后了。

ex.cn: 我们就住在挨着教堂那边的房子里。

ex.cn: 他匆匆走过他们身边，连停都没停。

ex.en: He just walked straight past us!
ex.cn: 他与我们擦肩而过！

ex.cn: 失业人数现在已超过了 300 万大关。

ex.cn: 这些花已过了盛开的季节。

ex.en: He's past his prime.
ex.cn: 他已不再年富力强了。

ex.cn: 她早已超过了退休年龄。

ex.cn: 老实说，我已什么事都不关心了。

senses.chn: （人）过老而无用；（物）旧得不宜使用

ex.cn: 在某些运动中，人过 25 岁就难有作为了。

ex.cn: 那件外衣看来绝对穿不出去了。

ex.cn: 他跑过时，我大声喊他。

ex.cn: 一个星期过去了，情况毫无变化。

a soft wet mixture, usually made of a powder and a liquid

ex.cn: 她把面粉和水和成细滑的面糊。

senses.chn: 肉（或鱼等）酱（作涂抹料或烹饪用）

ex.cn: 贴壁纸的糨糊

ex.cn: 他把画片贴到他的剪贴簿里。

ex.cn: 把这两片粘在一起。

ex.en: Paste down the edges.
ex.cn: 把边缘贴合起来。

ex.en: The children were busy cutting and pasting paper hats.
ex.cn: 孩子们忙着剪裁和粘贴纸帽子。

ex.en: This function allows you to cut and paste text.
ex.cn: 本功能可使你剪切并粘贴文本。

ex.cn: 剪切和粘贴比重新打字要快。

senses.def: a type of thin board made by sticking sheets of paper together
soft coloured chalk, used for drawing pictures

ex.en: drawings in pastel
ex.cn: 蜡笔画

senses.def: small sticks of chalk

ex.en: a box of pastels
ex.cn: 一盒粉笔

senses.def: a picture drawn with pastels
a pale delicate colour

ex.en: The whole house was painted in soft pastels.
ex.cn: 整座房屋都漆成柔和淡雅的色彩。

senses.def: the part of a horse's foot between the fetlock and the hoof
to heat a liquid, especially milk, to a particular temperature and then cool it, in order to kill harmful bacteria
a work of art, piece of writing, etc. that is created by deliberately copying the style of sb/sth else
senses.chn: 刻意模仿的文艺作品；模仿作品

ex.en: a pastiche of the classic detective story
ex.cn: 经典侦探故事的仿作

senses.def: a work of art, etc. that consists of a variety of different styles
senses.chn: （集多种风格于一身的）混成作品，集锦

senses.def: the art of creating a pastiche

ex.cn: 果味含片

ex.en: throat pastilles
ex.cn: 喉片

ex.cn: 她的主要爱好是音乐和园艺。

ex.cn: 他爱好游泳和烹饪。

ex.cn: 警察抓强盗的游戏

ex.cn: 他在逗狗玩。

ex.cn: 在法国，下馆子是全国性的消遣活动。

ex.cn: 他的主要业余爱好是踢足球（他踢足球）。

senses.chn: 法国茴香酒（常作开胃酒）

senses.def: too old to do what you used to be able to do; too old to be used for its normal function
senses.chn: （人）过老而无用；（物）旧得不宜使用

ex.cn: 在某些运动中，人过 25 岁就难有作为了。

ex.cn: 那件外衣看来绝对穿不出去了。

senses.chn: 完全正确的；准确的；地道的

ex.en: She speaks perfect English.
ex.cn: 她讲一口地道的英语。

ex.en: a perfect copy/fit/match
ex.cn: 精确的副本；绝对合身；天作之合

ex.en: What perfect timing!
ex.cn: 时机掌握得恰到好处！

senses.def: the best of its kind

ex.en: a perfect example of the painter's early style
ex.cn: 这位画家早期风格的典范

ex.en: the perfect crime (= one in which the criminal is never discovered)
ex.cn: 一桩无头案

senses.def: excellent; very good

ex.en: The weather was perfect.
ex.cn: 天气好极了。

ex.en: The rooms are excellent value at $20 a night.
ex.cn: 这些房间一晚 20 美元太合算了。

ex.en: He speaks excellent English.
ex.cn: 他英语说得棒极了。

ex.en: You can all come? Excellent!
ex.cn: 你们都能来？太好了！

ex.en: an outstanding achievement
ex.cn: 杰出的成绩

ex.en: Conditions were perfect for walking.
ex.cn: 散步的环境再好不过了。

senses.def: exactly right for sb/sth

ex.en: It was a perfect day for a picnic.
ex.cn: 那是野餐最理想的天气。

ex.en: She's the perfect candidate for the job.
ex.cn: 她是这项工作的最佳人选。

ex.en: 'Will 2.30 be OK for you?' 'Perfect, thanks.'
ex.cn: “ 2:30 对你合适吗？” “正合适，谢谢。”

senses.def: total; complete

ex.en: I don't know him—he's a perfect stranger.
ex.cn: 我不认识他，他是百分之百的陌生人。

senses.def: connected with the form of a verb that consists of part of the verb have with the past participle of the main verb, used to express actions completed by the present or a particular point in the past or future

ex.en: 'I have eaten' is the present perfect tense of the verb 'to eat', 'I had eaten' is the past perfect and 'I will have eaten' is the future perfect.
ex.cn: I have eaten 是动词 eat 的现在完成时；I had eaten 是过去完成时；I will have eaten 是将来完成时。

senses.def: a way of encouraging people by telling them that if you do an activity regularly and try to improve your skill, you will become very good at it
used to say that sth is what you would like to happen or what should happen, but you know it cannot

ex.en: In an ideal world we would be recycling and reusing everything.
ex.cn: 我们要是能回收并再利用所有的东西就再理想不过了。

senses.def: to make sth perfect or as good as you can

ex.en: As a musician, she has spent years perfecting her technique.
ex.cn: 身为音乐家，她多年来不断在技艺上精益求精。

senses.def: the form of a verb that expresses actions completed by the present or a particular point in the past or future, formed in English with part of the verb have and the past participle of the main verb
a way of making a book in which the pages are stuck together with glue rather than sewn together
the state of being perfect

ex.en: physical perfection
ex.cn: 体格健全

ex.en: The fish was cooked to perfection.
ex.cn: 这鱼烹得恰到好处。

ex.en: The novel achieves a perfection of form that is quite new.
ex.cn: 小说的形式新颖完美。

ex.en: His performance was perfection (= sth perfect).
ex.cn: 他的表演真是炉火纯青。

senses.def: the act of making sth perfect by doing the final improvements

ex.en: They have been working on the perfection of the new model.
ex.cn: 他们一直在努力完善新型号。

senses.def: advice that is good but that is difficult or impossible to follow
senses.chn: 听上去完美却难以实行的建议

senses.def: a person who likes to do things perfectly and is not satisfied with anything less
completely

ex.en: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
ex.cn: 有这样的感觉是完全正常的。

ex.en: It's perfectly good as it is (= it doesn't need changing).
ex.cn: 现在这样已经非常好了。

ex.en: You know perfectly well what I mean.
ex.cn: 我的意思你是一清二楚的。

ex.en: To be perfectly honest, I didn't want to go anyway.
ex.cn: 说真心话，反正我不想去。

ex.en: He stood perfectly still until the danger had passed.
ex.cn: 他一动不动地站在那里，直到危险解除。

ex.en: 'Do you understand?' 'Perfectly.'
ex.cn: “你明白吗？” “完全明白。”

senses.def: in a perfect way

ex.en: The TV works perfectly now.
ex.cn: 这台电视机现在状况好极了。

ex.en: It fits perfectly.
ex.cn: 那正合适。

senses.def: the ability to identify or sing a musical note correctly without the help of an instrument
senses.chn: 绝对音高，绝对音感（指不须借助乐器准确识别或唱出音符的能力）

senses.def: an occasion when several bad things happen at the same time, creating a situation that could not be worse
senses.chn: 祸不单行；屋漏偏逢连夜雨

senses.def: that cannot be trusted
senses.chn: 不可信任的；背叛的；不忠的

senses.def: unfair treatment of sb who trusts you
to make a hole or holes through sth

ex.en: The explosion perforated his eardrum.
ex.cn: 爆炸震破了他的耳膜。

ex.en: a perforated line (= a row of small holes in paper, made so that a part can be torn off easily)
ex.cn: 齿孔线

senses.def: a small hole in a surface, often one of a series of small holes

ex.en: Tear the sheet of stamps along the perforations.
ex.cn: 沿齿孔把邮票撕开。

senses.def: the process of splitting or tearing in such a way that a hole is left

ex.en: Excessive pressure can lead to perforation of the stomach wall.
ex.cn: 过大的压力会导致胃壁穿孔。

senses.def: because it is necessary or cannot be avoided
to do sth, such as a piece of work, task or duty

ex.en: to perform an experiment/a miracle/a ceremony
ex.cn: 做实验；创奇迹；举行仪式

ex.en: She performs an important role in our organization.
ex.cn: 她在我们的组织中发挥着重要的作用。

ex.en: This operation has never been performed in this country.
ex.cn: 这个国家从未做过这种手术。

ex.en: A computer can perform many tasks at once.
ex.cn: 电脑能同时执行多项任务。

senses.def: to entertain an audience by playing a piece of music, acting in a play, etc.

ex.en: to perform somersaults/magic tricks
ex.cn: 表演空翻／魔术

ex.en: The play was first performed in 2007.
ex.cn: 这部剧于 2007 年首次上演。

ex.en: I'd like to hear it performed live.
ex.cn: 我希望听现场演出。

ex.en: to perform on the flute
ex.cn: 吹奏长笛

ex.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you perform.
ex.cn: 我期待着看你演出。

senses.def: to work or function well or badly

ex.en: The engine seems to be performing well.
ex.cn: 发动机看起来运转良好。

ex.en: The company has been performing poorly over the past year.
ex.cn: 这家公司过去一年业绩欠佳。

senses.def: to achieve very good results

ex.en: Her exercise programme has worked miracles for her.
ex.cn: 她的健身计划对她很有效。

senses.def: the act of performing a play, concert or some other form of entertainment

ex.en: The performance starts at seven.
ex.cn: 演出七点开始。

ex.en: an evening performance
ex.cn: 晚场演出

ex.en: a performance of Ravel's String Quartet
ex.cn: 拉威尔弦乐四重奏的演出

ex.en: a series of performances by the Kirov Ballet
ex.cn: 基洛夫芭蕾舞团的系列演出

ex.en: one of the band's rare live performances
ex.cn: 那个乐队少见的一次现场演出

senses.def: the way a person performs in a play, concert, etc.

ex.en: She gave the greatest performance of her career.
ex.cn: 她做了演艺生涯中最精彩的表演。

ex.en: an Oscar-winning performance from Kate Winslet
ex.cn: 凯特 · 温斯莱特荣获奥斯卡奖的演出

senses.def: how well or badly you do sth; how well or badly sth works
senses.chn: 表现；性能；业绩；工作情况

ex.en: the country's economic performance
ex.cn: 国家的经济状况

ex.en: It was an impressive performance by the French team.
ex.cn: 那是法国队一次令人叹服的表现。

ex.en: The new management techniques aim to improve performance.
ex.cn: 新的管理技术旨在提高效率。

ex.en: He criticized the recent poor performance of the company.
ex.cn: 他批评公司近期业绩不佳。

ex.en: high-performance (= very powerful) cars
ex.cn: 高性能汽车

ex.en: performance indicators (= things that show how well or badly sth is working)
ex.cn: 性能指标

senses.def: the act or process of performing a task, an action, etc.

ex.en: She has shown enthusiasm in the performance of her duties.
ex.cn: 她在工作中表现出了热忱。

ex.en: He did not want a repeat performance of the humiliating defeat he had suffered.
ex.cn: 他不想让失败的耻辱重演。

senses.def: an act that involves a lot of effort or trouble, sometimes when it is not necessary

ex.en: It's such a performance getting the children off to school in the morning.
ex.cn: 早上打发孩子上学可要忙乱一阵子呢。

senses.def: an art form in which an artist gives a performance, rather than producing a physical work of art
senses.chn: 行为艺术（通过行为表现而非实物创作所展示的艺术形式）

senses.def: (of a substance, especially a drug) that people take so that they will be more successful in a sports competition
senses.chn: （尤指药物）兴奋性的（以提高在体育竞赛的表现）

ex.en: steroids and other performance-enhancing drugs
ex.cn: 类固醇等兴奋剂

senses.def: depending on how well a person does their job
senses.chn: 基于工作表现的；按绩效的

ex.en: Is there any evidence that performance-related pay actually improves performance?
ex.cn: 是否有证据表明绩效工资确实会提高业绩？

senses.def: when sb uses a performative word or expression, for example 'I promise' or 'I apologize', they are also doing sth (promising or apologizing)
senses.chn: 表述行为的（如说 I promise 或 I apologize，同时表示许诺或道歉）

senses.def: a person who performs for an audience in a show, concert, etc.

ex.en: a brilliant/polished/seasoned performer
ex.cn: 卓越的／优雅的／娴熟的表演者

senses.def: a person or thing that behaves or works in the way mentioned

ex.en: He was a poor performer at school and left with no qualifications.
ex.cn: 他在校学习成绩不好，没有毕业就离开学校。

ex.en: VW is the star performer of the motor industry this year.
ex.cn: 大众汽车在本年度汽车行业中出类拔萃。

senses.def: a liquid, often made from flowers, that you put on your skin to make yourself smell nice

ex.en: a bottle of expensive perfume
ex.cn: 一瓶昂贵的香水

ex.en: We stock a wide range of perfumes.
ex.cn: 我们备有各种各样的香水。

ex.en: the perfume counter of the store
ex.cn: 商店的香水柜台

ex.en: She was wearing too much perfume.
ex.cn: 她喷了太多的香水。

senses.def: a pleasant, often sweet, smell

ex.en: the heady perfume of the roses
ex.cn: 玫瑰扑鼻的香味

senses.def: to make the air in a place smell pleasant

ex.en: The garden was perfumed with the smell of roses.
ex.cn: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰的芳香。

senses.def: to put perfume in or on sth

ex.en: She perfumed her bath with fragrant oils.
ex.cn: 她沐浴时在浴缸内洒了些芳香油。

senses.def: a place where perfumes are made and/or sold
the process of making perfume
done as a duty or habit, without real interest, attention or feeling
senses.chn: 敷衍的；例行公事般的；潦草的

ex.en: a perfunctory nod/smile
ex.cn: 敷衍的点头／微笑

ex.en: They only made a perfunctory effort.
ex.cn: 他们只是敷衍了事。

senses.def: an arch in a garden/yard with a frame for plants to grow over and through
possibly

ex.en: 'Are you going to come?' 'Perhaps. I'll see how I feel.'
ex.cn: “你来不来？” “也许来。要看我身体情况了。”

ex.en: Perhaps he's forgotten.
ex.cn: 也许是他忘掉了。

senses.def: used when you want to make a statement or opinion less definite

ex.en: This is perhaps his best novel to date.
ex.cn: 这也许是他迄今最好的小说。

ex.en: Most cybercrime involves traditional crimes, such as theft and fraud, being committed in new ways. Phishing is perhaps / possibly / probably the best-known example of this.
ex.cn: 大多数网络犯罪都包含盗窃、诈骗等传统犯罪，只是犯罪的方式有了新的变化。网络钓鱼大概是这类犯罪中最著名的例子。

ex.en: It seems / appears that the more personal data which organizations collect, the more opportunity there is for this data to be lost or stolen.
ex.cn: 看来各种机构收集的个人资料越多，这些资料丢失或被盗的可能性就越大。

ex.en: It seems clear that introducing national ID cards would do little to prevent identity theft.
ex.cn: 看来很明显的是，采用全国通用身份证对防止身份盗用起不了什么作用。

ex.en: It could be argued that the introduction of national ID cards might actually make identity theft easier.
ex.cn: 可以说采用全国通用身份证实际上可能使身份盗用更容易。

ex.en: It is possible that / It may be that the only way to protect ourselves against DNA identity theft is to avoid the creation of national DNA databases.
ex.cn: 或许保护自己免遭 DNA 身份盗用的唯一途径就是不要建立全国 DNA 数据库。

senses.def: used when making a rough estimate

ex.en: a change which could affect perhaps 20% of the population
ex.cn: 一项可能影响 20% 的人口的改革

senses.def: used when you agree or accept sth unwillingly, or do not want to say strongly that you disapprove
senses.chn: （表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许，大概

ex.en: 'You could do it yourself.' 'Yeah, perhaps.'
ex.cn: “你可以自己做。” “嗯，也许吧。”

senses.def: used when making a polite request, offer or suggestion
senses.chn: （用于委婉的请求、主动承诺或提出建议）也许，如果

ex.en: Perhaps it would be better if you came back tomorrow.
ex.cn: 如果你明天回来，也许更好。

ex.en: I think perhaps you've had enough to drink tonight.
ex.cn: 我想今晚你已经喝得够多了。

senses.def: the point in the orbit of the moon, a planet or other object in space when it is nearest the planet, for example the earth, around which it turns
senses.chn: 近地点（绕地运动的天体轨道上离地心最近点）

senses.def: serious danger

ex.en: The country's economy is now in grave peril.
ex.cn: 现在，这个国家的经济陷入了严重危机。

senses.def: the fact of sth being dangerous or harmful

ex.en: a warning about the perils of drug abuse
ex.cn: 对吸毒之害的警告

senses.def: used to warn sb that if they do sth, it may be dangerous or cause them problems
very dangerous
the outside edge of an area of land

ex.en: Guards patrol the perimeter of the estate.
ex.cn: 保安人员在庄园四周巡逻。

ex.en: a perimeter fence/track/wall
ex.cn: 围绕四周的栅栏／小径／墙

senses.def: the total length of the outside edge of an area or a shape
at or around the time of birth
senses.chn: 围生期的；围产期的；临产的

ex.en: perinatal care
ex.cn: 围生期护理

ex.en: perinatal mortality
ex.cn: 围生期死亡率

senses.def: the area between the anus and the scrotum or vulva
a particular length of time

ex.en: a period of consultation/mourning/uncertainty
ex.cn: 磋商／哀悼／形势不明朗的期间

ex.en: The factory will be closed down over a 2-year period/a period of two years.
ex.cn: 这家工厂将在两年内关闭。

ex.en: This compares with a 4% increase for the same period last year.
ex.cn: 这个数字与去年同期的 4% 升幅相近。

ex.en: This offer is available for a limited period only.
ex.cn: 这项优惠仅在限期内有效。

ex.en: All these changes happened over a period of time.
ex.cn: 所有这些变化都是在一段时间内发生的。

ex.en: The aim is to reduce traffic at peak periods.
ex.cn: 目的是降低高峰时段的交通流量。

senses.def: a length of time in the life of a particular person or in the history of a particular country
senses.chn: （人生或国家历史的）阶段，时期，时代

ex.en: Which period of history would you most like to have lived in?
ex.cn: 你最喜欢生活在哪一个历史时期？

ex.en: the post-war period
ex.cn: 战后时期

ex.en: Like Picasso, she too had a blue period.
ex.cn: 和毕加索一样，她也有过一段以蓝色为主调的创作时期。

ex.en: Most teenagers go through a period of rebelling.
ex.cn: 大多数青少年都要经历一段叛逆期。

senses.def: a length of time which is a division of an era. A period is divided into epochs.
senses.chn: 纪（地质年代，代下分纪，纪下分世）

ex.en: the Jurassic period
ex.cn: 侏罗纪

senses.def: any of the parts that a day is divided into at a school, college, etc. for study

ex.en: 'What do you have next period?' 'French.'
ex.cn: “你下一节是什么课？” “法语。”

ex.en: a free/study period (= for private study)
ex.cn: 自习课

senses.def: the flow of blood each month from the body of a woman who is not pregnant

ex.en: period pains
ex.cn: 痛经

ex.en: monthly periods
ex.cn: 月经

ex.en: When did you last have a period?
ex.cn: 你上一次月经是什么时候？

senses.def: the mark ( . ) used at the end of a sentence and in some abbreviations, for example e.g.
used at the end of a sentence to emphasize that there is nothing more to say about a subject
senses.chn: （用于句末，强调不再多说）到此为止，就是这话

ex.en: The answer is no, period!
ex.cn: 答复是不，不再说了！

senses.def: having a style typical of a particular time in history

ex.en: period costumes/furniture
ex.cn: 代表某一时期的服装／家具

senses.def: happening fairly often and regularly
senses.chn: 间发性的；定期的；周期的

ex.en: Periodic checks are carried out on the equipment.
ex.cn: 设备定期进行检查。

senses.def: a magazine that is published every week, month, etc., especially one that is concerned with an academic subject
related to or affecting the parts of the mouth that surround and support the teeth
a condition in which the area around the teeth becomes sore and swollen, which may make the teeth fall out
a play, film/movie, etc. that is set in a particular period of history
a decorative object, piece of furniture, etc. that was made during a particular period of history and is typical of that period
senses.chn: 具有某个时代特征的装饰品（或家具等）

senses.def: going from place to place, for example in order to work

ex.en: a peripatetic music teacher
ex.cn: 一名流动的音乐教师

senses.def: not as important as the main aim, part, etc. of sth

ex.en: peripheral information
ex.cn: 辅助信息

ex.cn: 相对于他们的主要活动，筹集资金是次要的。

senses.def: connected with the outer edge of a particular area

ex.en: the peripheral nervous system
ex.cn: 周围神经系统

ex.en: peripheral vision
ex.cn: 周边视觉

senses.def: connected to a computer

ex.en: a peripheral device
ex.cn: 外围设备

senses.def: a piece of equipment that is connected to a computer

ex.en: monitors, printers and other peripherals
ex.cn: 显示器、打印机及其他外围设备

example.en: Fund-raising is peripheral to their main activities.
example.cn: 相对于他们的主要活动，筹集资金是次要的。

senses.def: the outer edge of a particular area

ex.en: industrial development on the periphery of the town
ex.cn: 城镇周边地区工业的发展

ex.en: The condition makes it difficult for patients to see objects at the periphery of their vision.
ex.cn: 这种病症使患者难于看见视觉边缘的物体。

senses.def: the less important part of sth, for example of a particular activity or of a social or political group
senses.chn: 次要部分；次要活动；边缘

ex.en: minor parties on the periphery of American politics
ex.cn: 处于美国政治边缘的小党派

senses.def: the use of an indirect way of speaking or writing
the use of separate words to express a grammatical relationship, instead of verb endings, etc.
senses.chn: 加词表达法，迂说法（非通过词缀等表示语法关系）

to die, especially in a sudden violent way

ex.cn: 一家四口死于此次火灾之中。

senses.def: to be lost or destroyed

ex.cn: 早期建筑物为木质结构，已经消失殆尽。

used to say that you find a suggestion unacceptable or that you hope that sth will never happen
senses.chn: （用于拒绝一项建议或希望某事永不发生）没门儿，甭想了，下辈子吧

ex.cn: 我结婚？下辈子再说吧！

ex.cn: 易腐烂变质的商品／食物

very cold

ex.cn: 我们冷极了。

senses.chn: 小孩；（尤指）淘气包，讨厌鬼

senses.def: extremely cold

ex.cn: 外边冷极了。

ex.en: I'm perishing!
ex.cn: 我都快冻死了！

senses.def: used to show that you are annoyed about sth

ex.en: I've had enough of this perishing job!
ex.cn: 这讨厌的差事，我真受够了！

senses.chn: （用于拒绝一项建议或希望某事永不发生）没门儿，甭想了，下辈子吧

ex.en: Me get married? Perish the thought!
ex.cn: 我结婚？下辈子再说吧！

senses.def: the wave-like movements of the intestine, etc. caused when the muscles contract and relax
the membrane on the inside of the abdomen (= very thin layer of tissue ) on the inside of the abdomen that covers the stomach and other organs

senses.chn: 可怜的；令人怜悯的；令人同情的

ex.en: a piteous cry/sight
ex.cn: 可怜的哭声／景象

senses.def: a danger or difficulty, especially one that is hidden or not obvious at first
senses.chn: 危险；困难；（尤指）陷阱，隐患

ex.en: the potential pitfalls of buying a house
ex.cn: 购买房屋可能遇到的圈套

senses.def: a soft dry white substance inside the skin of oranges and some other fruits
the essential or most important part of sth

ex.en: the pith of her argument
ex.cn: 她论据的核心

senses.def: the entrance to a coal mine and the offices, machinery, etc. in the area around it
senses.chn: 矿井井口；坑口周围设施

senses.def: a light hard hat worn to give protection from the sun in very hot countries
short but expressed well and full of meaning
deserving pity or causing you to feel pity

ex.en: The refugees were in a pitiable state.
ex.cn: 难民处境可怜。

senses.def: not deserving respect

ex.en: a pitiable lack of talent
ex.cn: 令人遗憾的无能表现

senses.def: deserving pity or causing you to feel pity
senses.chn: 可怜的；令人怜悯的；令人同情的

ex.en: The horse was a pitiful sight (= because it was very thin or sick).
ex.cn: 这匹马看上去可怜兮兮的。

senses.def: not deserving respect

ex.en: a pitiful effort/excuse/performance
ex.cn: 不值一提的努力／借口／表现

senses.def: showing no pity; cruel

ex.en: a pitiless killer/tyrant
ex.cn: 残忍的凶手／暴君

senses.def: very cruel or severe, and never ending

ex.en: a scorching, pitiless sun
ex.cn: 灼热的骄阳

senses.def: a short pointed piece of metal used in rock-climbing. The piton is fixed into the rock and has a rope attached to it through a ring at the other end.
a small horse that was used in the past for moving coal in a mine
a large piece of wood used to support the roof of part of a coal mine from which coal has been removed
an occasion when a car stops during a race for more fuel, etc.
a short stop during a long trip for a rest, a meal, etc.
senses.chn: （长途旅行中的）短暂休息，歇脚

senses.def: a type of flat bread in the shape of an oval that can be split open and filled
senses.chn: 皮塔饼，填馅面包，口袋面包（一种扁平的椭圆面包，可加入馅料）

senses.def: a very small amount of money that sb receives, for example as a wage, and that is hardly enough to live on
senses.chn: 微薄的工资；极少的报酬

ex.en: to pay sb a pittance
ex.cn: 付给某人菲薄的工资

ex.en: to work for a pittance
ex.cn: 为一点小钱而工作

senses.def: having small marks or holes in the surface
senses.chn: 表面有小点（或小洞）的；坑坑洼洼的

senses.def: having had the large hard seed (= the pit) removed

ex.en: pitted olives
ex.cn: 去核橄榄

senses.def: an industrial city in the US state of Pennsylvania
senses.chn: 匹兹堡（美国宾夕法尼亚州工业城市）

senses.def: a small organ at the base of the brain that produces hormones that influence growth and sexual development
a feeling of sympathy and sadness caused by the suffering and troubles of others

ex.en: I could only feel pity for what they were enduring.
ex.cn: 对他们所受的苦难我唯有同情而已。

ex.en: a look/feeling/surge of pity
ex.cn: 怜悯的表情／感觉／涌动

ex.en: I took pity on her and lent her the money.
ex.cn: 我同情她，就把钱借给了她。

ex.en: I beg you to have pity on him.
ex.cn: 请你可怜可怜他吧。

ex.en: I don't want your pity.
ex.cn: 我用不着你可怜。

senses.def: used to show that you are disappointed about sth

ex.en: It's a pity that you can't stay longer.
ex.cn: 你不能再多停留些时间，真是遗憾。

ex.en: 'I've lost it!' 'Oh, what a pity.'
ex.cn: “我把东西弄丢了！” “哎呀，真可惜。”

ex.en: What a pity that she didn't tell me earlier.
ex.cn: 真遗憾，她没有早点告诉我。

ex.en: It seems a pity to waste this food.
ex.cn: 浪费这些食物真可惜。

ex.en: This dress is really nice. Pity it's so expensive.
ex.cn: 这件连衣裙真不错，只可惜太贵了。

ex.en: Oh, that's a pity.
ex.cn: 唉，那可真遗憾。

senses.def: unfortunately

ex.en: 'Was the bicycle insured?' 'No, more's the pity!'
ex.cn: “自行车上保险没有？” “没有。真倒霉！”

senses.def: to feel sorry for sb because of their situation; to feel pity for sb

ex.en: He pitied people who were stuck in dead-end jobs.
ex.cn: 他很同情那些工作上毫无前途的人。

ex.en: Compulsive gamblers are more to be pitied than condemned.
ex.cn: 对嗜赌成瘾者要多些同情，少些谴责。

ex.en: I pity her having to work such long hours.
ex.cn: 她不得不加班加点工作，真让我同情。

example.en: It's a pity that you can't stay longer.
example.cn: 你不能再多停留些时间，真是遗憾。

example.en: It seems a pity to waste this food.
example.cn: 浪费这些食物真可惜。

example.en: He pitied people who were stuck in dead-end jobs.
example.cn: 他很同情那些工作上毫无前途的人。

example.en: I pity her having to work such long hours.
example.cn: 她不得不加班加点工作，真让我同情。

senses.def: showing pity for sb, often in a way that shows that you think you are better than them
senses.chn: 怜悯的，同情的（常带优越感）

ex.en: a pitying look/smile
ex.cn: 垂怜的眼神／微笑

senses.def: the central point, pin or column on which sth turns or balances
the central or most important person or thing
senses.chn: 最重要的人（或事物）；中心；核心

ex.en: West Africa was the pivot of the cocoa trade.
ex.cn: 西非曾是可可豆贸易的中心。

ex.en: The pivot on which the old system turned had disappeared.
ex.cn: 维系旧制度的支柱已经消失了。

senses.def: to turn or balance on a central point (= a pivot ); to make sth do this

ex.en: Windows that pivot from a central point are easy to clean.
ex.cn: 沿中轴转动的窗子容易擦洗。

ex.en: She pivoted around and walked out.
ex.cn: 她一转身走了出去。

senses.def: to depend completely on sth
of great importance because other things depend on it

ex.en: a pivotal role in European affairs
ex.cn: 在欧洲事务中的关键作用

senses.def: any of the small individual areas on a computer screen, which together form the whole display
senses.chn: 像素（组成屏幕图像的最小独立元素）

senses.def: to divide an image into pixels
senses.chn: 使像素化；将（图像）分解成像素

senses.def: to show an image on television as a small number of large pixels, especially in order to hide sb's identity
senses.chn: （尤指为了不透露当事人身份而）使电视图像模糊，打上马赛克

senses.def: (in stories) a creature like a small person with pointed ears, who has magic powers
senses.chn: （传说中的）小精灵，小仙子，小妖怪

senses.def: an Italian dish consisting of a flat round bread base with cheese, tomatoes, vegetables, meat, etc. on top

ex.en: a ham and mushroom pizza
ex.cn: 火腿蘑菇比萨饼

ex.en: Is there any pizza left?
ex.cn: 还有比萨饼吗？

senses.def: a lively and exciting quality or style

ex.en: We need someone with youth, glamour and pizzazz.
ex.cn: 我们需要一位年富力强、魅力十足、风度翩翩的人。

senses.def: a restaurant that serves mainly pizzas
played using the fingers instead of a bow2 (3) to pull at the strings of a musical instrument such as a violin
a large written or printed notice that is put in a public place or carried on a stick in a march
senses.chn: 标语牌；广告牌；招贴；海报

ex.en: They were carrying placards and banners demanding that he resign.
ex.cn: 人们手持标语牌和横幅，要求他下台。

senses.def: to make sb feel less angry about sth

ex.en: a placating smile
ex.cn: 安抚的微笑

ex.en: The concessions did little to placate the students.
ex.cn: 让步根本未能平息学生的愤怒。

senses.def: designed to make sb feel less angry by showing that you are willing to satisfy or please them
senses.chn: 和解的；安抚性的；安慰的

ex.en: a placatory remark/smile/gesture
ex.cn: 抚慰的话／微笑／姿态

senses.def: a particular position, point or area

ex.en: Is this the place where it happened?
ex.cn: 这就是事发现场吗？

ex.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
ex.cn: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

ex.en: I can't be in two places at once.
ex.cn: 我不能同时身处两地。

senses.def: a particular city, town, building, etc.
senses.chn: 某处地方（如城镇或建筑物等）

ex.en: I can't remember all the places we visited in Thailand.
ex.cn: 我记不清在泰国参观过的所有地方。

ex.en: I used to live in York and I'm still fond of the place.
ex.cn: 我以前住在约克，现在仍然喜欢那里。

ex.en: The police searched the place.
ex.cn: 警察搜查了那个地方。

ex.en: We were looking for a place to eat.
ex.cn: 我们想找个吃饭的地方。

ex.en: Let's get out of this place!
ex.cn: 咱们离开这儿吧！

senses.def: a building or an area of land used for a particular purpose
senses.chn: 有某用途的建筑（或土地）

ex.en: a meeting place
ex.cn: 聚会地点

ex.en: The town has many excellent eating places.
ex.cn: 镇上有许多很棒的餐馆。

ex.en: churches and other places of worship
ex.cn: 教堂和其他礼拜场所

ex.en: He can usually be contacted at his place of work.
ex.cn: 一般都能在他的工作单位找到他。

ex.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
ex.cn: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

ex.en: They've chosen a site for the new school.
ex.cn: 他们为新学校选了校址。

senses.def: a particular area on a surface, especially on a person's body
senses.chn: 表面的某处；（尤指）身体某处

ex.en: He broke his arm in three places.
ex.cn: 他胳膊上有三处骨折。

ex.en: The paint was peeling off the wall in places.
ex.cn: 墙上有几处油漆剥落了。

senses.def: a point in a book, speech, piece of music, etc., especially one that sb has reached at a particular time
senses.chn: 段；点；节；（尤指）读到的（或说到的）某点

ex.en: She had marked her place with a bookmark.
ex.cn: 她把书签夹在读到的地方。

ex.en: Excuse me, I seem to have lost my place.
ex.cn: 对不起，我好像忘记说到哪里了。

senses.def: a position, seat, etc., especially one that is available for or being used by a person or vehicle
senses.chn: （尤指占用或空着的）座位，位置，泊位

ex.en: Come and sit here—I've saved you a place.
ex.cn: 到这儿来坐吧。我给你留了个座位。

ex.en: I don't want to lose my place in the line.
ex.cn: 我可不想失去排队的位置。

ex.en: Would you like to change places with me so you can see better?
ex.cn: 你想跟我换个位子看得更清楚点吗？

ex.en: I've set a place for you at the table.
ex.cn: 我在餐桌上给你安排好了座位。

senses.def: the role or importance of sb/sth in a particular situation, usually in relation to others

ex.en: He is assured of his place in history.
ex.cn: 他必定会被载入史册。

ex.en: Accurate reporting takes second place to lurid detail.
ex.cn: 准确的报道在其次，耸人听闻的细节最重要。

ex.en: My father believed that people should know their place (= behave according to their social position).
ex.cn: 我父亲认为人应该安分守己。

ex.en: It's not your place (= your role) to give advice.
ex.cn: 还轮不到你来做指导。

ex.en: Anecdotes have no place in (= are not acceptable in) an academic essay.
ex.cn: 学术文章容不得奇闻逸事。

senses.def: an opportunity to take part in sth, especially to study at a school or university or on a course
senses.chn: 求学机会；进修机会；入学名额

ex.en: She's been offered a place at Bath to study Business.
ex.cn: 她已被录取到巴斯大学读商科。

ex.en: There are very few places left on the course.
ex.cn: 这门课程没剩几个名额了。

senses.def: the position of being a member of a sports team

ex.en: She has won a place in the Olympic team.
ex.cn: 她已获得奥运代表队的队员资格。

ex.en: He lost his place in the first team.
ex.cn: 他失去了在一队的资格。

senses.def: the natural or correct position for sth

ex.en: Is there a place on the form to put your address?
ex.cn: 表格上有填写地址的位置吗？

ex.en: Put it back in its place when you've finished with it.
ex.cn: 用毕放回原处。

senses.def: a suitable or safe area for sb to be

ex.en: These streets are no place for a child to be out alone at night.
ex.cn: 这些街道可不是小孩子夜间单独去的地方。

senses.def: a house or flat/apartment; a person's home

ex.en: What about dinner at my place?
ex.cn: 到我家吃晚饭好不好？

ex.en: I'm fed up with living with my parents, so I'm looking for a place of my own.
ex.cn: 我腻烦跟父母同住了，所以正在找一个属于自己的住处。

senses.def: a position among the winners of a race or competition
senses.chn: （速度比赛或竞赛获胜者的）名次

ex.en: He finished in third place.
ex.cn: 他得了第三名。

senses.def: the position of a figure after a decimal point

ex.en: The number is correct to three decimal places.
ex.cn: 这个数目精确到小数点后三位数。

senses.def: used as part of a name for a short street or square
senses.chn: （作短街道或广场名称的一部分）

ex.en: 66 Portland Place
ex.cn: 波特兰街 66 号

senses.def: everywhere

ex.en: New restaurants are appearing all over the place.
ex.cn: 新餐馆如雨后春笋般纷纷出现了。

senses.def: not neat or tidy; not well organized

ex.en: Your calculations are all over the place (= completely wrong).
ex.cn: 你的计算错得一塌糊涂。

senses.def: to be in sb else's situation

ex.en: I'm perfectly happy—I wouldn't change places with anyone.
ex.cn: 我幸福极了，谁也甭想跟我交换位置。

senses.def: if sth complicated or difficult to understand falls or slots into place, it becomes organized or clear in your mind
to be replaced by sb/sth

ex.en: Houses and factories gave place to open fields as the train gathered speed.
ex.cn: 火车逐渐加速驶过了房屋和工厂进入旷野。

senses.def: to be getting more and more successful in your life or career

ex.en: a young architect who's really going places
ex.cn: 一个春风得意的青年建筑师

senses.def: used to introduce a piece of advice you are giving to sb
senses.chn: 若是换了我呀；我若在你的位置

ex.en: If I were in your place, I'd resign immediately.
ex.cn: 我要是你呀，我就立即辞职。

senses.def: used at the end of a sentence to talk about why sth was done or whether it should have been done or not
senses.chn: （用于句尾，谈论某事为何或是否应该做）究竟，到底，当初

ex.en: I still don't understand why you chose that name in the first place.
ex.cn: 我仍不明白你究竟为什么取了这么个名字。

ex.en: I should never have taken that job in the first place.
ex.cn: 我当初就不该接受那份工作。

senses.def: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the different points you are making in an argument

ex.en: Well, in the first place he has all the right qualifications.
ex.cn: 嗯，首先，他符合一切条件。

senses.def: to be feeling positive, sad, worried, etc. about sth; to be in a good, bad, worrying state

ex.en: I'm happy now. I'm in a good place.
ex.cn: 我现在很高兴，感觉良好。

senses.def: in my, your, etc. situation

ex.en: I wouldn't like to be in your place.
ex.cn: 我可不想处于你的境地。

senses.def: in the correct position; ready for sth

ex.en: Carefully lay each slab in place.
ex.cn: 要仔细铺好每一块石板。

ex.en: The receiver had already clicked into place.
ex.cn: 听筒咔的一声放回原位了。

senses.def: working or ready to work

ex.en: All the arrangements are now in place for their visit.
ex.cn: 他们来访的一切事宜都安排好了。

senses.def: instead of sb/sth

ex.en: You can use milk in place of cream in this recipe.
ex.cn: 这道食谱可以用牛奶代替奶油。

ex.en: He was unable to come to the ceremony, but he sent his son to accept the award in his place.
ex.cn: 他不能亲自来参加仪式，但派了他儿子前来代他领奖。

senses.def: not in the correct place

ex.en: Some of these files seem to be out of place.
ex.cn: 有些档案似乎没放对地方。

senses.def: not suitable for a particular situation

ex.en: Her remarks were out of place.
ex.cn: 她出言不当。

ex.en: I felt completely out of place among all these successful people.
ex.cn: 夹在这些事业有成的人中间我觉得自己格格不入。

senses.def: a position in which you are comfortable or have an advantage over other people
senses.chn: 舒适的状态；有利地位；优越境况

senses.def: to imagine that you are in sb else's situation
senses.chn: 设身处地替别人着想；设想自己处于别人的境地

ex.en: Of course I was upset—just put yourself in my place.
ex.cn: 我当然不高兴，你设身处地为我想想。

senses.def: to make sb feel stupid or embarrassed for showing too much confidence
senses.chn: 挫某人的锐气；杀某人的威风；使明白自己的身份

ex.en: At first she tried to take charge of the meeting but I soon put her in her place.
ex.cn: 起初她试图主导会议，但我很快就把她轰下去了。

senses.def: to happen, especially after previously being arranged or planned
senses.chn: （尤指根据安排或计划）发生，进行

ex.en: The film festival takes place in October.
ex.cn: 电影节将于十月举行。

ex.en: We may never discover what took place that night.
ex.cn: 我们可能永远不会知道那一夜发生了什么事。

senses.def: to replace sb/sth

ex.en: She couldn't attend the meeting so her assistant took her place.
ex.cn: 她不能参加会议，所以她的助手代她出席。

ex.en: Computers have taken the place of typewriters in most offices.
ex.cn: 在大多数办公室，电脑已经取代了打字机。

senses.def: to go to the physical position that is necessary for an activity

ex.en: Take your places for dinner.
ex.cn: 请各位入席。

senses.def: to take or accept the status in society that is correct or that you deserve
senses.chn: 得到应有的社会地位；名副其实

senses.def: to look extremely clean and neat
used to say that sb's intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.chn: 本意是好的；心眼是好的

senses.def: an unusual or unpleasant event is not likely to happen in the same place or to the same people twice
senses.chn: 倒霉的事不可能在同一场所（或同一人身上）重复发生；一事不过二

senses.def: to behave in a very confident way that annoys other people, for example by telling them what to do
the position in which sth is most easily seen, that is given to the most important thing in a particular group
senses.chn: 显要位置；最突出（或最重要）的位置

senses.def: in a situation where you have to choose between two things, both of which are unpleasant
to put sth in a particular place, especially when you do it carefully or deliberately

ex.en: He placed his hand on her shoulder.
ex.cn: 他把手搭在她的肩上。

ex.en: A bomb had been placed under the seat.
ex.cn: 座位下面放了一枚炸弹。

ex.en: The parking areas in the town are few, but strategically placed.
ex.cn: 城内停车场虽少，但都设在关键地方。

senses.def: to put sb/yourself in a particular situation
senses.chn: 使（人）处于某位置；安置；安顿

ex.en: to place sb in command
ex.cn: 让某人指挥

ex.en: She was placed in the care of an uncle.
ex.cn: 她由一位叔父照顾。

ex.en: His resignation placed us in a difficult position.
ex.cn: 他的辞职使我们不知所措。

ex.en: The job places great demands on me.
ex.cn: 这项工作对我的要求很高。

senses.def: used to express the attitude sb has towards sb/sth
senses.chn: 以某种态度对待（或看待）

ex.en: Great emphasis is placed on education.
ex.cn: 教育受到高度重视。

ex.en: They place a high value on punctuality.
ex.cn: 他们对守时极为重视。

senses.def: to recognize sb/sth and be able to identify them/it

ex.en: I've seen her before but I just can't place her.
ex.cn: 我从前见过她，不过现在认不出她来。

ex.en: His accent was impossible to place.
ex.cn: 他的口音无法辨认。

senses.def: to give instructions about sth or make a request for sth to happen

ex.en: to place a bet/an order
ex.cn: 下注；下订单

ex.en: We placed an advertisement for a cleaner in the local paper.
ex.cn: 我们在本地报纸上登了广告，招一名清洁工。

senses.def: to find a suitable home, job, etc. for sb

ex.en: The children were placed with foster parents.
ex.cn: 这些小孩已安顿好，交给寄养父母了。

ex.en: The agency placed about 2 000 secretaries last year.
ex.cn: 去年，这家中介所为大约 2 000 名秘书找到了工作。

senses.def: to decide that sb/sth has a particular position or rank compared with other people or things

ex.en: I would place her among the top five tennis players in the world.
ex.cn: 我会把她排在世界五名顶尖网球选手之列。

ex.en: Information about safety procedures is in the pocket in front of you (= on a plane).
ex.cn: 安全求生的资料放在您前方的小袋子里。

senses.def: used to talk about the amount of money that you have to spend

ex.en: We have holidays to suit every pocket.
ex.cn: 我们有适合各种程度消费的度假方式。

ex.en: He had no intention of paying for the meal out of his own pocket.
ex.cn: 他不想自己掏腰包付饭钱。

ex.en: The Foundation is reputed to have very deep pockets (= to have a lot of money).
ex.cn: 据说这个基金会资金雄厚。

senses.def: a small group or area that is different from its surroundings
senses.chn: （与周围不同的）小组织，小区域

ex.en: There are still a few isolated pockets of resistance to the new regime.
ex.cn: 现在仍有零星孤立的势力反对新政权。

ex.en: a pocket of air
ex.cn: 气井

senses.def: any of the holes or nets around the edges of the table used in the games of billiards, pool or snooker, which you have to hit the ball into
to be controlled or strongly influenced by sb
senses.chn: 受某人的控制（或极大影响）；在某人掌握之中

senses.def: if two people are in each other's pockets, they are too close to each other or spend too much time with each other
to have influence or power over sb, for example, a police officer or a politician, especially by threatening them or by offering them money
senses.chn: 驾驭，让…听使唤（尤指通过恐吓或贿赂）

senses.def: to be certain to win sth
having gained/lost money as a result of sth

ex.en: That one mistake left him thousands of pounds out of pocket.
ex.cn: 那一次失误让他损失了数千英镑。

senses.def: if money burns a hole in your pocket, you want to spend it as soon as you have it
senses.chn: 一有（钱）就想花；花钱没有节制

senses.def: to spend some of your own money on sth
to spend money or give it to sb

ex.en: I've heard he doesn't like putting his hand in his pocket.
ex.cn: 我听说他手很紧。

senses.def: to get richer or make sb richer, especially by taking unfair advantage of a situation or by being dishonest
senses.chn: （尤指通过占便宜或欺诈而）中饱私囊，（使）发财

senses.def: to steal sth from sb's pocket without them noticing
to put sth into your pocket

ex.en: She paid for the drink and pocketed the change without counting it.
ex.cn: 她付了饮料费，把找回的零钱数都没数就装进了口袋。

senses.def: to take or keep sth, especially an amount of money, that does not belong to you

ex.en: He regularly charges passengers more than the normal fare and pockets the difference.
ex.cn: 他经常多收乘客票钱，把差额塞进自己的腰包。

senses.def: to earn or win an amount of money

ex.en: Last year, she pocketed over $1 million in advertising contracts.
ex.cn: 去年，她从广告合同中赚了 100 多万美元。

senses.def: to hit a ball into a pocket (5)
used to refer to the financial situation of a person or country. (In the past it was a small flat case for carrying papers or money.)
senses.chn: （个人或国家的）财政状况，财力，钱袋子

ex.en: Many foreign goods are too expensive for American pocketbooks.
ex.cn: 许多外国货都太贵，与一般美国人的财力不符。

ex.en: The increase is likely to hit the pocketbooks of consumers.
ex.cn: 提价可能会砸到消费者的钱袋子。

senses.def: a small book for writing in
the amount a pocket holds

ex.en: a pocketful of coins
ex.cn: 一衣袋硬币

senses.def: a small amount of money that parents give their children, usually every week or every month
a small amount of money that you can spend on things you need or want
small enough to fit into your pocket or to be carried easily
(in the US) a method by which the President can stop a new law from being introduced by not signing it and keeping it until a session of Congress has finished
senses.chn: 搁置否决（美国总统阻止新法律实施的一种方法，即不予签字并将其保留至国会休会后）

senses.def: a hollow mark on the skin, often caused by disease or infection
senses.chn: （皮肤上的）痘痕，麻子，麻点，麻坑

senses.def: covered with hollow marks or holes

ex.en: a pock-marked face
ex.cn: 一张麻子脸

ex.en: The district is pock-marked with caves.
ex.cn: 这个地区布满了坑洞。

senses.def: a long thin case filled with seeds that develops from the flowers of some plants, especially peas and beans

ex.en: a pea pod
ex.cn: 豌豆荚

ex.en: a vanilla pod
ex.cn: 香子兰蒴果

senses.def: a long narrow container that is hung under an aircraft and used to carry fuel, equipment, weapons, etc.
part of a spacecraft or a boat that can be separated from the main part
a small group of sea animals, such as dolphins or whales, swimming together
senses.chn: （海豚或鲸等海洋动物的）一小群

ex.en: a pod of adult dolphins
ex.cn: 一小群成年海豚

senses.def: a digital audio file that can be taken from the Internet and played on a computer or a device that you can carry with you

ex.en: To listen to the podcast, click on the link below.
ex.cn: 点击下面的链接收听播客。

senses.def: slightly fat

ex.en: podgy arms
ex.cn: 胖乎乎的胳膊

senses.def: a small platform that a person stands on when giving a speech or conducting an orchestra, etc.
senses.chn: 讲台；讲坛；（乐队的）指挥台

senses.def: small, dull and not important

a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their sound and the images they suggest, not just for their obvious meanings. The words are arranged in separate lines, usually with a repeated rhythm, and often the lines rhyme at the end.
poetry
a person who writes poems
a woman who writes poems
connected with poetry; being poetry

ex.en: poetic language
ex.cn: 诗歌语言

ex.en: Byron's Poetical Works
ex.cn: 拜伦诗作

senses.def: like or suggesting poetry, especially because it shows imagination and deep feeling
senses.chn: 像诗一般的；富有诗意的

ex.en: There is a poetic quality to her playing.
ex.cn: 她的演奏富有诗意。

senses.def: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.chn: 艺术上自由发挥的权利；诗的破格

senses.def: a situation in which sth bad happens to sb, and you think that this is what they deserve
the freedom to change facts, the normal rules of language, etc. in a special piece of writing or speech in order to achieve a particular effect
senses.chn: （写作或演讲中的）破格修辞法，破格用语

senses.def: the art of writing poetry
the study of poetry, literature, etc.
(especially in Britain) a person who has been officially chosen to write poetry for the country's important occasions
senses.chn: 桂冠诗人（尤指英国正式选定为国家重要场合赋诗者）

senses.def: a person whose poetry is considered to be the best, or most typical of their country or region
senses.chn: （某国或地区的）最杰出诗人，代表诗人

senses.def: a collection of poems; poems in general

ex.en: epic/lyric/pastoral, etc. poetry
ex.cn: 史诗、抒情诗、田园诗等

ex.en: Maya Angelou's poetry
ex.cn: 玛雅 · 安吉罗的诗作

ex.en: a poetry reading
ex.cn: 诗歌朗诵

senses.def: a beautiful and elegant quality
senses.chn: 美好的品质；优雅的气质；诗意

ex.en: There was poetry in all her gestures.
ex.cn: 她一举一动都很优美。

senses.def: looking very serious and as though you do not approve of sb/sth
senses.chn: 一本正经的；不以为然的；孤傲的；板着脸的

senses.def: a pole with a bar to stand on and a spring at the bottom, that you jump around on for fun
the organized killing of large numbers of people, because of their race or religion (originally the killing of Jews in Russia)
senses.chn: 大屠杀，集体迫害（因种族或宗教原因，原指沙俄时对犹太人的杀戮）

senses.def: having a strong effect on your feelings, especially in a way that makes you feel sad
senses.chn: 令人沉痛的；悲惨的；酸楚的

ex.en: a poignant image/moment/memory, etc.
ex.cn: 悲惨的形象、时刻、回忆等

ex.en: Her face was a poignant reminder of the passing of time.
ex.cn: 她的容颜显示了时间的流逝，令人感伤。

senses.def: a tropical plant with large red or pink leaves that grow to look like flowers, often grown indoors in pots
a thing that sb says or writes giving their opinion or stating a fact

ex.en: She made several interesting points in the article.
ex.cn: 她在文章中提出了几个有趣的观点。

ex.en: I take your point (= understand and accept what you are saying).
ex.cn: 我赞同你的看法。

ex.en: He's just saying that to prove a point (= to show his idea is right).
ex.cn: 他那样说只是为了证明他的看法。

ex.en: OK, you've made your point!
ex.cn: 好了，你已经把话说清楚了！

senses.def: the main or most important idea in sth that is said or done

ex.en: The point is you shouldn't have to wait so long to see a doctor.
ex.cn: 关键是看病不该等那么长时间。

ex.en: I wish he would get to the point (= say it quickly).
ex.cn: 但愿他快点说正题。

ex.en: I'll come straight to the point: we need more money.
ex.cn: 我就直说吧：我们还需要钱。

ex.en: Do you see my point (= understand)?
ex.cn: 你明白我的意思吗？

ex.en: I think I missed the point (= did not understand).
ex.cn: 我想我没听懂。

ex.en: You have a point (= your idea is right) —it would be better to wait till this evening.
ex.cn: 你说的有道理，还是等到今天晚上比较好。

senses.def: the purpose or aim of sth

ex.en: What's the point of all this violence?
ex.cn: 这些暴行的意图何在？

ex.en: There's no point in getting angry.
ex.cn: 发火是没有用的。

ex.en: I don't see the point of doing it all again.
ex.cn: 我就不明白，再做一次有什么意义。

ex.en: The point of the lesson is to compare the two countries.
ex.cn: 本课的目的是比较这两个国家。

ex.en: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.
ex.cn: 我们这次活动的主要目的是募款。

ex.en: She went to London with the aim of finding a job.
ex.cn: 她去伦敦是为了找工作。

senses.def: a particular detail or fact

ex.en: Here are the main points of the news.
ex.cn: 以下是新闻摘要。

ex.en: Can you explain that point again?
ex.cn: 你能再解释一下那一点吗？

senses.def: a particular quality or feature that sb/sth has

ex.en: Tact is not one of her strong points.
ex.cn: 她不善于圆通处事。

ex.en: Read the manual to learn the program's finer points (= small details).
ex.cn: 读一下指南，以了解这一程序的细节。

ex.en: Living in Scotland has its good points but the weather is not one of them.
ex.cn: 在苏格兰生活有其优点，但天气不好。

ex.en: One of the hotel's plus points (= good features) is that it is very central.
ex.cn: 这个旅馆的一大优点是它位于市中心。

senses.def: a particular time or stage of development

ex.en: The climber was at/on the point of death when they found him.
ex.cn: 当他们发现那个登山者的时候，他已奄奄一息。

ex.en: We were on the point of giving up.
ex.cn: 我们当时几乎要放弃了。

ex.en: Many people suffer from mental illness at some point in their lives.
ex.cn: 许多人在人生的某个阶段都会得精神疾病。

ex.en: We had reached the point when there was no money left.
ex.cn: 我们曾落到身无分文的地步。

ex.en: At this point in time we just have to wait.
ex.cn: 到这种时刻，我们只好等待了。

ex.en: At this point I don't care what you decide to do.
ex.cn: 到这个时候，我不在乎你决定要怎么做了。

senses.def: a particular place or area

ex.en: I'll wait for you at the meeting point in the arrivals hall.
ex.cn: 我将在到港大厅的迎接处等你。

ex.en: the point at which the river divides
ex.cn: 河流分叉点

ex.en: Draw a line from point A to point B.
ex.cn: 从 A 点到 B 点画一条线。

ex.en: No parking beyond this point.
ex.cn: 请勿越界停车。

ex.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
ex.cn: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

ex.en: They've chosen a site for the new school.
ex.cn: 他们为新学校选了校址。

senses.def: one of the marks of direction around a compass

ex.en: the points of the compass (= N, S, E, W, etc.)
ex.cn: 罗盘上的罗经点

senses.def: an individual unit that adds to a score in a game or sports competition

ex.en: to win/lose a point
ex.cn: 赢／输一分

ex.en: Australia finished 20 points ahead.
ex.cn: 澳大利亚队终局领先 20 分。

ex.en: They won on points (= by scoring more points rather than by completely defeating their opponents).
ex.cn: 他们以点数取胜。

senses.def: a mark or unit on a scale of measurement

ex.en: The party's share of the vote fell by ten percentage points.
ex.cn: 该党的得票率下跌了十个百分点。

senses.def: the sharp thin end of sth

ex.en: the point of a pencil/knife/pin
ex.cn: 铅笔／刀／大头针尖

senses.def: a narrow piece of land that stretches into the sea

ex.en: The ship sailed around the point.
ex.cn: 那条船绕过了岬角。

ex.en: Pagoda Point
ex.cn: 宝塔角

senses.def: a small dot used in writing, especially the dot that separates a whole number from the part that comes after it

ex.en: two point six (2.6)
ex.cn: 二点六

ex.en: a decimal point
ex.cn: 小数点

ex.en: We broadcast on ninety-five point nine (95.9) FM.
ex.cn: 我们以调频 95.9 播音。

senses.def: a very small dot of light or colour

ex.en: The stars were points of light in the sky.
ex.cn: 天空中的点点光亮就是星星。

senses.def: a place in a wall, etc. where a piece of equipment can be connected to electricity

ex.en: a power/shaver/telephone point
ex.cn: 电源／剃须刀／电话插座

senses.def: a piece of track at a place where a railway/railroad line divides that can be moved to allow a train to change tracks
a unit of measurement for the size of letters in printing or on a computer screen, etc.
senses.chn: （印刷物或计算机屏幕上字体大小的单位）点，磅值

ex.en: Change the text to 10 point.
ex.cn: 把文本字体大小变为 10 点。

senses.def: used when you have to decide sth or say what you really think
senses.chn: 必须作决定（或亮明观点）时

ex.en: When it comes to the point, he always changes his mind.
ex.cn: 他总是关键时候变卦。

senses.def: used to say what is true in a situation

ex.en: In point of fact, she is their adopted daughter.
ex.cn: 实际上，她是他们的养女。

senses.def: to be or make sure you do sth because it is important or necessary
senses.chn: （因重要或必要）保证做，必定做

ex.en: I made a point of closing all the windows before leaving the house.
ex.cn: 我离家前必定要把所有的窗子都关好。

senses.def: used to say that sth is more important than sth else

ex.en: I couldn't do the job—I've never been to Spain and, more to the point, I don't speak Spanish.
ex.cn: 这个工作我做不了——我从未去过西班牙；而更重要的是，我不会说西班牙语。

senses.def: appropriate or relevant to the situation

ex.en: The quotation was directly on point.
ex.cn: 这段话引用得恰到好处。

ex.en: Let's stay on point.
ex.cn: 咱们不要偏离主题。

senses.def: a place where you go or a person that you speak to when you are dealing with an organization

ex.en: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
ex.cn: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

senses.def: a place where a journey starts
an idea, a theory or an event that is used to start a discussion, an activity, etc.
a thing that sb considers to be very important for their honour or reputation
the time when you must continue with what you have decided to do, because it is not possible to get back to an earlier situation
senses.chn: 欲罢不能的时刻；已无退路；不可能回头

senses.def: used to say that you accept that sb else is right when they have disagreed with you or criticized you
senses.chn: （接受相反的意见）同意，好吧，算你有理

ex.en: Point taken. Let's drop the subject.
ex.cn: 好吧。咱们就抛开这个话题吧。

senses.def: expressed in a simple, clear way without any extra information or feelings

ex.en: The letter was short and to the point.
ex.cn: 这封信简短扼要。

senses.def: to a degree that can be described as sth

ex.en: He was rude to the point of being aggressive.
ex.cn: 他粗鲁到蛮不讲理的地步。

senses.def: to some extent; to some degree but not completely

ex.en: I agree with you up to a point.
ex.cn: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。

senses.def: to repeat an idea, argument, etc. many times to emphasize it, especially when it has already been mentioned or understood
senses.chn: 一再强调观点（或论点等）

senses.def: a clear example of the problem, situation, etc. that is being discussed

ex.en: The website has a variety of interactive exercises (e.g. matching games, crosswords and quizzes).
ex.cn: 这个网站有各种各样的互动练习（比如：配对游戏、纵横填字游戏和智力测试）。

ex.en: The website has a variety of interactive exercises, including matching games, crosswords and quizzes.
ex.cn: 这个网站有各种各样的互动练习，包括配对游戏、纵横填字游戏和智力测试。

ex.en: Web 2.0 technologies, such as wikis, blogs and social networking sites, have changed the way that people use the Internet. *
ex.cn: Web 2.0 技术，比如维基、博客及社交网站，改变了人们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Many websites now allow users to contribute information. A good example of this is the 'wiki', a type of website that anyone can edit.
ex.cn: 现在许多网站都允许用户撰写信息。维基就是一个很好的例子，它是一种任何人都可以编辑的网站。

ex.en: Wikis vary in how open they are. For example, some wikis allow anybody to edit content, while others only allow registered users to do this.
ex.cn: 各维基网的开放程度不同。比如，有些维基网允许任何人编辑内容，另一些则只允许注册用户进行内容编辑。

ex.en: Wikis vary in how open they are. Some wikis, for example / for instance, allow anybody to edit content, while others only allow registered users to do this.
ex.cn: 各维基网的开放程度不同。比如，有些维基网允许任何人编辑内容，另一些则只允许注册用户进行内容编辑。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism
senses.chn: 直截了当地说，不客气地说（尤指批评）

ex.en: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.
ex.cn: 不客气地说，我认为你在撒谎。

senses.def: to continue to repeat or explain sth that has already been said and understood
senses.chn: 一再重复，反复解释（已说明的事）

senses.def: a matter about which there may be disagreement or confusion
senses.chn: 悬而未决的事；有争议的问题

senses.def: a subject that makes you feel angry or upset when it is mentioned

ex.en: It's a sore point with Sue's parents that the children have not been baptized yet.
ex.cn: 孩子们至今未受洗礼，这是休的父母的一块心病。

senses.def: to allow or do sth that is not usually acceptable, especially because of a particular situation
to stretch out your finger or sth held in your hand towards sb/sth in order to show sb where a person or thing is

ex.en: 'What's your name?' he asked, pointing at the child with his pen.
ex.cn: 他用笔指着小孩问：“你叫什么名字？”

ex.en: He pointed to the spot where the house used to stand.
ex.cn: 他指出那所房子原来所在的地方。

ex.en: She pointed in my direction.
ex.cn: 她指向我这边。

ex.en: It's rude to point!
ex.cn: 用手指人很不礼貌啊！

ex.en: She pointed her finger in my direction.
ex.cn: 她指着我这个方向。

senses.def: to aim sth at sb/sth

ex.en: He pointed the gun at her head.
ex.cn: 他举枪对准了她的头。

senses.def: to face in or be directed towards a particular direction

ex.en: The telescope was pointing in the wrong direction.
ex.cn: 望远镜对错了方向。

ex.en: The signpost pointed straight ahead.
ex.cn: 路标直指前方。

ex.en: A compass needle points north.
ex.cn: 罗盘指针指向北方。

senses.def: to lead to or suggest a particular development or logical argument

ex.en: The evidence seems to point in that direction.
ex.cn: 证据似乎指向那个方向。

ex.en: The fans are looking to the new players to point the way to victory.
ex.cn: 球迷都在指望新球员打出胜利之路。

senses.def: to show sb which way to go

ex.en: I wonder if you could point me in the right direction for the bus station.
ex.cn: 请问您能指点我到公共汽车站往哪个方向走吗？

ex.en: A series of yellow arrows pointed the way to reception.
ex.cn: 连续的黄色箭头标出了通往接待处的路。

senses.def: to put mortar between the bricks of a wall
to accuse sb of doing sth

ex.en: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.
ex.cn: 那篇文章谴责了当局。

senses.def: to stretch your finger out towards sb/sth in order to show sb which person or thing you are referring to

ex.en: I'll point him out to you next time he comes in.
ex.cn: 他下次进来的时候，我指给你看。

senses.def: to mention sth in order to give sb information about it or make them notice it

ex.en: She tried in vain to point out to him the unfairness of his actions.
ex.cn: 她试图向他指出他的做法不公正，但无济于事。

ex.en: He pointed out the dangers of driving alone.
ex.cn: 他指出单独驾车的危险性。

ex.en: I should point out that not one of these paintings is original.
ex.cn: 我应当指出，这些画中没有一幅是真迹。

ex.en: 'It's not very far,' she pointed out.
ex.cn: “那里不太远。” 她说道。

ex.en: Some critics argue that Picasso remained a great master all his life.
ex.cn: 一些评论家认为毕加索毕生都是一位大师。

ex.en: Others maintain that there is a significant deterioration in quality in his post-war work.
ex.cn: 其他人坚称他战后的作品质量明显下降。

senses.def: to mention sth that you think is important and/or the reason why a particular situation exists
senses.chn: 提出，指出（重要的事或理由）

ex.en: The board of directors pointed to falling productivity to justify their decision.
ex.cn: 董事会指出生产率下降一事为其决策辩护。
