ex.cn: 把盒子竖着放。

ex.en: Make sure that you are working in a comfortable position.
ex.cn: 工作时一定要保持舒适的姿势。

ex.en: My arms were aching so I shifted (my) position slightly.
ex.cn: 我胳膊疼了，所以稍微变了变姿势。

senses.def: the situation that sb is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do

ex.en: to be in a position of power/strength/authority
ex.cn: 处于有权力／有实力／有权威的地位

ex.en: What would you do in my position?
ex.cn: 你要是碰到我这样的情况会怎么办？

ex.en: This put him and his colleagues in a difficult position.
ex.cn: 这使他和他的同事陷于困境。

ex.en: The company's financial position is not certain.
ex.cn: 这家公司的财务状况不明朗。

ex.en: I'm afraid I am not in a position to help you.
ex.cn: 我恐怕帮不了你。

ex.en: the present economic situation
ex.cn: 目前的经济形势

senses.def: an opinion on or an attitude towards a particular subject

ex.en: to declare/reconsider/shift/change your position
ex.cn: 表明／重新考虑／转变／改变立场

ex.en: the party's position on education reforms
ex.cn: 这个党对教育改革的态度

ex.en: She has made her position very clear.
ex.cn: 她明确表示了自己的立场。

ex.en: My parents always took the position that early nights meant healthy children.
ex.cn: 我的父母总是认为孩子早睡就会身体健康。

senses.def: a person or organization's level of importance when compared with others

ex.en: the position of women in society
ex.cn: 妇女的社会地位

ex.en: the company's dominant position in the world market
ex.cn: 那个公司在全球市场中的主导地位

ex.en: Wealth and position (= high social status) were not important to her.
ex.cn: 财富与地位对她并不重要。

senses.def: a job

ex.en: He held a senior position in a large company.
ex.cn: 他在一家大公司担任高级职务。

ex.en: I should like to apply for the position of Sales Director.
ex.cn: 我想申请销售总监一职。

ex.en: He's trying to get a job in a bank.
ex.cn: 他正设法在银行找一个工作。

ex.en: a senior position in a large corporation
ex.cn: 在一家大公司的高级职务

ex.en: a key post in the new government
ex.cn: 在新政府中的要职

ex.en: We have several vacancies for casual workers.
ex.cn: 我们有几个临时工的空缺。

senses.def: a place in a race, competition, or test, when compared to others

ex.en: United's 3–0 win moved them up to third position.
ex.cn: 联队 3:0 的胜利使他们排名升至第三。

senses.def: the place where sb plays and the responsibilities they have in some team games

ex.en: What position does he play?
ex.cn: 他打哪个位置？

senses.def: a place where a group of people involved in fighting have put men and guns

ex.en: They attacked the enemy positions at dawn.
ex.cn: 黎明时分，他们向敌军阵地发起进攻。

senses.def: to put sb/sth in a particular position

ex.en: Large television screens were positioned at either end of the stadium.
ex.cn: 体育场的两端安装了大型电视屏幕。

ex.en: She quickly positioned herself behind the desk.
ex.cn: 她迅速在桌子后面她的位置上坐好。

ex.en: The company is now well positioned to compete in foreign markets.
ex.cn: 现在这家公司已准备好在国外市场竞争。

example.en: I'm afraid I am not in a position to help you.
example.cn: 我恐怕帮不了你。

senses.def: connected with the position of sb/sth
senses.chn: 位置上的；地位上的；职位上的

ex.en: The team has made some positional changes because two players are injured.
ex.cn: 因有两名队员受伤，这个队将队员做了些位置上的调整。

senses.def: a written report from an organization or a government department that explains or recommends a particular course of action
senses.chn: （机构或政府部门的）行动报告，施政说明，建议书

senses.def: thinking about what is good in a situation; feeling confident and sure that sth good will happen

ex.en: a positive attitude/outlook
ex.cn: 乐观的态度／前景

ex.en: the power of positive thought
ex.cn: 乐观思想的力量

ex.en: She tried to be more positive about her new job.
ex.cn: 她努力更积极地投入新工作。

ex.en: On the positive side, profits have increased.
ex.cn: 从好的方面看，利润增加了。

ex.en: The report ended on a positive note.
ex.cn: 报告的结尾显得很乐观。

senses.def: directed at dealing with sth or producing a successful result
senses.chn: 积极的；建设性的；朝着成功的

ex.en: We must take positive steps to deal with the problem.
ex.cn: 我们必须采取积极措施处理这个问题。

ex.en: It will require positive action by all in the industry.
ex.cn: 这将需要业内全体同人和衷共济。

senses.def: expressing agreement or support

ex.en: We've had a very positive response to the idea.
ex.cn: 我们这个想法反响很好。

senses.def: good or useful
senses.chn: 良好的；有助益的；正面的

ex.en: to make a positive contribution to a discussion
ex.cn: 给讨论会提出好的建言

ex.en: His family have been a very positive influence on him.
ex.cn: 他的家庭对他有十分良好的影响。

ex.en: Overseas investment has had a positive effect on exports.
ex.cn: 海外投资对出口有积极影响。

senses.def: completely sure that sth is correct or true

ex.en: I can't be positive about what time it happened.
ex.cn: 我说不准这事是什么时间发生的。

ex.en: She was positive that he had been there.
ex.cn: 她确信他曾在场。

ex.en: 'Are you sure?' 'Positive.'
ex.cn: “你敢肯定吗？” “绝对肯定。”

ex.en: 'Is that John over there?' 'I'm not sure.'
ex.cn: “那边那个人是约翰吗？” “我说不准。”

ex.en: Are you sure about that?
ex.cn: 这事你肯定吗？

ex.en: England must win this game to be sure of qualifying.
ex.cn: 英格兰队必须拿下这场比赛才能确保获得资格。

senses.def: complete and definite

ex.en: He has a positive genius for upsetting people.
ex.cn: 他气人的本事可大呢。

ex.en: It was a positive miracle that we survived.
ex.cn: 我们能够生还，完全是个奇迹。

senses.def: giving clear and definite proof or information

ex.en: We have no positive evidence that she was involved.
ex.cn: 我们没有确凿证据证明她参与其事。

ex.en: This is proof positive that he stole the money.
ex.cn: 这就是他偷钱的确证。

senses.def: showing clear evidence that a particular substance or medical condition is present

ex.en: a positive pregnancy test
ex.cn: 呈阳性反应的怀孕检测

ex.en: The athlete tested positive for steroids.
ex.cn: 这个运动员类固醇检测呈阳性。

ex.en: to be HIV positive
ex.cn: 艾滋病病毒化验呈阳性

senses.def: greater than zero
containing or producing the type of electricity that is carried by a proton

ex.en: a positive charge
ex.cn: 正电荷

ex.en: the positive terminal of a battery
ex.cn: 电池的正极

senses.def: a good or useful quality or aspect

ex.en: Take your weaknesses and translate them into positives.
ex.cn: 把你的弱点变成优点。

senses.def: a developed film showing light and dark areas and colours as they actually were, especially one printed from a negative
the result of a test or an experiment that shows that a substance or condition is present

example.en: She tried to be more positive about her new job.
example.cn: 她努力更积极地投入新工作。

example.en: She was positive that he had been there.
example.cn: 她确信他曾在场。

senses.def: the practice or policy of making sure that a particular number of jobs, etc. are given to people from groups that are often treated unfairly because of their race, sex, etc.
senses.chn: 积极区别对待政策（对因种族、性别等原因遭歧视的群体在就业等方面给予特别照顾）

senses.def: used to emphasize the truth of a statement, especially when this is surprising or when it contrasts with a previous statement

ex.en: The instructions were not just confusing, they were positively misleading.
ex.cn: 这些指示不单令人费解，而且肯定会误导人。

senses.def: in a way that shows you are thinking of the good things about a situation, not the bad

ex.en: Very few of those interviewed spoke positively about their childhood.
ex.cn: 接受采访的人当中，很少有人说他们的童年是快乐的。

ex.en: Thinking positively is one way of dealing with stress.
ex.cn: 保持乐观是对付压力的一种方法。

senses.def: in a way that shows you approve of or agree with sth/sb

ex.en: Investors reacted positively to news of the takeover.
ex.cn: 投资者对公司收购的消息反应积极。

senses.def: in a way that leaves no possibility of doubt

ex.en: Her attacker has now been positively identified by police.
ex.cn: 袭击她的人现在已被警方确认。

senses.def: in a way that contains or produces the type of electricity that is opposite to that carried by an electron

ex.en: positively charged protons
ex.cn: 带正电的质子

senses.def: the process of checking everything about a person's background and character when they apply for a job in which they will have to deal with secret information, especially in the civil service
senses.chn: 道德审查（对申请从事保密工作者的背景和品行进行检查）

senses.def: a system of philosophy based on things that can be seen or proved, rather than on ideas
senses.chn: 实证主义；实证哲学；实证论

senses.def: a particle in an atom which has the same mass as an electron and an equal but positive charge
possible

ex.en: I'll be there if poss.
ex.cn: 如果可能，我会去那里的。

ex.en: as soon as poss
ex.cn: 尽快

senses.def: a group of people who are similar in some way, or who spend time together
senses.chn: 一群，一队，一伙（有共同之处的人）

ex.en: a little posse of helpers
ex.cn: 一小伙帮忙的人

senses.def: (in the US in the past) a group of people who were brought together by a sheriff (= an officer of the law) in order to help him catch a criminal
senses.chn: （美国旧时由县治安官调集、协助捉拿罪犯的）地方武装团队

senses.def: a group of young men involved in crime connected with drugs
senses.chn: （与毒品有关的）青年犯罪团伙

senses.def: to have or own sth

ex.en: He was charged with possessing a shotgun without a licence.
ex.cn: 他被控无照拥有猎枪。

ex.en: The gallery possesses a number of the artist's early works.
ex.cn: 这家画廊藏有那位画家的一些早期作品。

senses.def: to have a particular quality or feature

ex.en: I'm afraid he doesn't possess a sense of humour.
ex.cn: 恐怕他没有什么幽默感。

senses.def: to have a powerful effect on sb and control the way that they think, behave, etc.
to make sb do sth that seems strange or unreasonable

ex.en: What possessed him to say such a thing?
ex.cn: 他着了什么魔竟说出这种话来？

senses.def: controlled by an evil spirit

ex.en: She has convinced herself that she is possessed by the devil.
ex.cn: 她确信自己被魔鬼附了身。

senses.def: to have a particular quality or feature

ex.en: She was possessed of exceptional powers of concentration.
ex.cn: 她有高超的专注能力。

senses.def: with a lot of force or energy
senses.chn: 着了魔似的；拼命地；猛烈地

ex.en: He flew out of the room like a man possessed.
ex.cn: 他猛然冲出房门，像着了魔似的。

senses.def: the state of having or owning sth

ex.en: The manuscript is just one of the treasures in their possession.
ex.cn: 这部手稿只是他们的珍藏之一。

ex.en: The gang was caught in possession of stolen goods.
ex.cn: 这伙人被逮住，人赃俱获。

ex.en: The possession of a passport is essential for foreign travel.
ex.cn: 出国旅行必须持有护照。

ex.en: On her father's death, she came into possession of (= received) a vast fortune.
ex.cn: 她父亲死后，她继承了一大笔财产。

ex.en: You cannot legally take possession of the property (= start using it after buying it) until three weeks after the contract is signed.
ex.cn: 契约签署三周以后，你才能合法取得这份产业的所有权。

senses.def: something that you own or have with you at a particular time

ex.en: personal possessions
ex.cn: 私人物品

ex.en: The ring is one of her most treasured possessions.
ex.cn: 这只戒指是她最珍贵的财产之一。

ex.en: Shall I help you pack your things?
ex.cn: 我帮你打点行装好吗？

ex.en: Bring your swimming things.
ex.cn: 随身带上游泳用品。

ex.en: Where's all my stuff?
ex.cn: 我那些东西都哪儿去了？

ex.en: This building is government property.
ex.cn: 这座大楼是政府的财产。

senses.def: the state of having control of the ball

ex.en: to win/get/lose possession of the ball
ex.cn: 赢得／得到／失去对球的控制

senses.def: the state of having illegal drugs or weapons with you at a particular time
senses.chn: 持有违禁物；私藏毒品（或武器）

ex.en: She was charged with possession.
ex.cn: 她被控持有违禁物品。

senses.def: a country that is controlled or governed by another country
the situation when sb's mind is believed to be controlled by the Devil or by an evil spirit
if you already have or control sth, it is difficult for sb else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.chn: 现实占有，败一胜九；占有者在诉讼中总占上风

senses.def: to enable sb to be successful in a particular area of activity because other people or groups have given up competing with them
senses.chn: 为…的胜利铺平道路；为…的成功扫清障碍

possession is nine tenths of the law.lemma: possession is nine tenths of the law

senses.def: if you already have or control sth, it is difficult for sb else to take it away from you, even if they have the legal right to it
senses.chn: 现实占有，败一胜九；占有者在诉讼中总占上风

senses.def: demanding total attention or love; not wanting sb to be independent
senses.chn: 要求悉心关爱的；占有欲强的

ex.en: Some parents are too possessive of their children.
ex.cn: 有些父母过分要求子女百依百顺。

senses.def: not liking to lend things or share things with others
senses.chn: 不愿分享的；有独占欲望的

ex.en: Jimmy's very possessive about his toys.
ex.cn: 吉米的玩具谁也碰不得。

senses.def: showing that sth belongs to sb/sth
senses.chn: 表示所属关系的；所有格的

ex.en: possessive pronouns (= yours, theirs, etc.)
ex.cn: 物主代词

senses.def: a pronoun or a form of a word that expresses the fact that sth belongs to sb/sth

ex.en: 'Ours' and 'their' are possessives.
ex.cn: ours 和 their 是所有格形式。

senses.def: the special form of a word that expresses belonging
a person who owns or has sth

ex.en: He is now the proud possessor of a driving licence.
ex.cn: 他现在有了驾驶执照，颇有些飘飘然。

senses.def: in the past, a drink made with hot milk and beer or wine
senses.chn: 牛奶甜酒（旧时用热牛奶加啤酒或葡萄酒调制而成）

senses.def: a dessert made with cream and fruit, often lemons
senses.chn: 奶油水果甜点（水果常用柠檬）

senses.def: if a baby possets, milk comes back up from its stomach and out through its mouth
the fact that sth might exist or happen, but is not certain to

ex.en: There is now no possibility that she will make a full recovery.
ex.cn: 她现在已不可能完全康复。

ex.en: He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
ex.cn: 他拒绝排除增税的可能性。

ex.en: It is not beyond the bounds of possibility that we'll all meet again one day.
ex.cn: 我们大家将来有一天再度聚在一起，并非绝不可能。

ex.en: Bankruptcy is a real possibility if sales don't improve.
ex.cn: 如果销售情况得不到改善，真有破产的可能。

ex.en: What had seemed impossible now seemed a distinct possibility.
ex.cn: 过去看似不可能的事，现在显然有可能了。

senses.def: one of the different things that you can do in a particular situation

ex.en: to explore/consider/investigate a wide range of possibilities
ex.cn: 探究／考虑／调查各种可能的情况

ex.en: to exhaust all the possibilities
ex.cn: 用尽一切可能的手段

ex.en: Selling the house is just one possibility that is open to us.
ex.cn: 卖掉房子只是我们可以选择的其中一种做法。

ex.en: The possibilities are endless.
ex.cn: 可想的办法是无穷的。

ex.en: As I see it, we have two options…
ex.cn: 据我看，我们有两种选择…

ex.en: Students have the option of studying abroad in their second year.
ex.cn: 学生在二年级时可以选择出国学习。

senses.def: something that gives you a chance to achieve sth

ex.en: The course offers a range of exciting possibilities for developing your skills.
ex.cn: 这门课程可提供一整套新鲜活泼的技能训练。

senses.def: if sth has possibilities, it can be improved or made successful

ex.en: The house is in a bad state of repair but it has possibilities.
ex.cn: 这房子虽亟待修缮，但仍有可资利用的价值。

example.en: There is now no possibility that she will make a full recovery.
example.cn: 她现在已不可能完全康复。

example.en: He refused to rule out the possibility of a tax increase.
example.cn: 他拒绝排除增税的可能性。

senses.def: that can be done or achieved

ex.en: It is possible to get there by bus.
ex.cn: 可以乘公共汽车到那里。

ex.en: Would it be possible for me to leave a message for her?
ex.cn: 我可以给她留个话儿吗？

ex.en: This wouldn't have been possible without you.
ex.cn: 若没有你，这事恐怕就办不成了。

ex.en: Try to avoid losing your temper if at all possible (= if you can).
ex.cn: 尽可能别发脾气。

ex.en: Use public transport whenever possible (= when you can).
ex.cn: 只要可能，就利用公共交通。

ex.en: It's just not physically possible to finish all this by the end of the week.
ex.cn: 要在本周末完成这一切，这在客观上是办不到的。

senses.def: that might exist or happen but is not certain to

ex.en: a possible future president
ex.cn: 未来可能当选总统的人

ex.en: the possible side effects of the drug
ex.cn: 这种药可能产生的副作用

ex.en: Frost is possible, although unlikely, at this time of year.
ex.cn: 每年这个时节都有可能下霜，只是并不常见。

ex.en: It's just possible that I gave them the wrong directions.
ex.cn: 我也许给他们指错了方向。

ex.en: With the possible exception of the Beatles, no other band has become so successful so quickly.
ex.cn: 可能除了披头士乐队这个例外，还没有哪个乐队如此转瞬走红的。

ex.en: Most cybercrime involves traditional crimes, such as theft and fraud, being committed in new ways. Phishing is perhaps / possibly / probably the best-known example of this.
ex.cn: 大多数网络犯罪都包含盗窃、诈骗等传统犯罪，只是犯罪的方式有了新的变化。网络钓鱼大概是这类犯罪中最著名的例子。

senses.def: reasonable or acceptable in a particular situation

ex.en: There are several possible explanations.
ex.cn: 有几种合理的解释。

senses.def: used after adjectives to emphasize that sth is the best, worst, etc. of its type
senses.chn: （用于形容词后表示强调）最…的

ex.en: It was the best possible surprise anyone could have given me.
ex.cn: 那是我曾感受过的最大惊喜。

ex.en: Don't leave your packing until the last possible moment.
ex.cn: 打点行李不要拖到最后一刻。

senses.def: as quickly, much, soon, etc. as you can

ex.en: We will get your order to you as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 我们将会把您的订货尽早送达。

senses.def: the benefits of two or more completely different situations that you can enjoy at the same time
senses.chn: 两种（或多种）不同情况的优点；两全其美

ex.en: If you enjoy the coast and the country, you'll get the best of both worlds on this walk.
ex.cn: 你要是喜欢海滨和乡村，那么这次散步你会一举两得。

senses.def: all the disadvantages of every situation
senses.chn: 各种情况的所有不利因素

senses.def: a person or thing that is suitable for a particular job, purpose, etc. and might be chosen
senses.chn: 合适的人（或物）；恰当人选（或事项）

ex.en: Out of all the people interviewed, there are only five possibles.
ex.cn: 在所有面试过的人中，仅有五个合适的人选。

senses.def: used to say that sth might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain

ex.en: It was possibly their worst performance ever.
ex.cn: 这也许是他们迄今为止最糟糕的表现。

ex.en: She found it difficult to get on with her, possibly because of the difference in their ages.
ex.cn: 她觉得很难与她相处，这可能是因为她们年龄上的差距。

ex.en: 'Will you be around next week?' 'Possibly.'
ex.cn: “你下周过来吗？” “也许吧。”

ex.en: Most cybercrime involves traditional crimes, such as theft and fraud, being committed in new ways. Phishing is perhaps / possibly / probably the best-known example of this.
ex.cn: 大多数网络犯罪都包含盗窃、诈骗等传统犯罪，只是犯罪的方式有了新的变化。网络钓鱼大概是这类犯罪中最著名的例子。

ex.en: It seems / appears that the more personal data which organizations collect, the more opportunity there is for this data to be lost or stolen.
ex.cn: 看来各种机构收集的个人资料越多，这些资料丢失或被盗的可能性就越大。

ex.en: It seems clear that introducing national ID cards would do little to prevent identity theft.
ex.cn: 看来很明显的是，采用全国通用身份证对防止身份盗用起不了什么作用。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are surprised, annoyed, etc. about sth

ex.en: You can't possibly mean that!
ex.cn: 你绝不会是那个意思吧！

senses.def: used to ask sb politely to do sth

ex.en: Could you possibly open that window?
ex.cn: 请你把那扇窗子打开好吗？

senses.def: used to say that sb will do or has done as much as they can in order to make sth happen

ex.en: I will come as soon as I possibly can.
ex.cn: 我会尽快赶来的。

ex.cn: 我们共度时光的珍贵回忆

ex.en: a priceless collection of antiques
ex.cn: 价值连城的古文物收藏

senses.def: valuable or important and not to be wasted

ex.en: Clean water is a precious commodity in that part of the world.
ex.cn: 在世界的那个地方，洁净的水是宝贵的东西。

ex.en: You're wasting precious time!
ex.cn: 你在浪费宝贵的时间！

senses.def: loved or valued very much

ex.en: precious memories/possessions
ex.cn: 珍贵的回忆／财物

senses.def: used to show you are angry that another person thinks sth is very important

ex.en: I didn't touch your precious car!
ex.cn: 我没碰你那辆宝贝车！

senses.def: very formal, exaggerated and not natural in what you say and do
senses.chn: 道貌岸然的；矫揉造作的

senses.def: used to emphasize the fact that there is very little of sth or that there are very few of sth

ex.en: There's precious little to do in this town.
ex.cn: 这个镇上没有多少可做的事。

senses.def: a very valuable metal such as gold or silver
a rare valuable stone, such as a diamond, that is used in jewellery
a very steep side of a high cliff, mountain or rock

ex.en: The country was now on the edge of a precipice (= very close to disaster).
ex.cn: 这个国家现在情势岌岌可危。

senses.def: to make sth, especially sth bad, happen suddenly or sooner than it should
senses.chn: 使…突然降临；加速（坏事的发生）

ex.en: His resignation precipitated a leadership crisis.
ex.cn: 他的辞职立即引发了领导层的危机。

senses.def: to suddenly force sb/sth into a particular state or condition

ex.en: The assassination of the president precipitated the country into war.
ex.cn: 总统被暗杀使国家骤然陷入战争状态。

senses.def: happening very quickly or suddenly and usually without enough care and thought
a solid substance that has been separated from a liquid in a chemical process
rain, snow, etc. that falls; the amount of this that falls
senses.chn: 降水，降水量（包括雨、雪、冰等）

ex.en: an increase in annual precipitation
ex.cn: 年降水量的增加

senses.def: a chemical process in which solid material is separated from a liquid
very steep, high and often dangerous

ex.en: precipitous cliffs
ex.cn: 险峻的峭壁

ex.en: a precipitous drop at the side of the road
ex.cn: 道路一旁陡降的坡面

senses.def: sudden and great

ex.en: a precipitous decline in exports
ex.cn: 出口的急剧下降

senses.def: done very quickly, without enough thought or care

ex.en: a precipitous action
ex.cn: 贸然行动

senses.def: a short version of a speech or a piece of writing that gives the main points or ideas

ex.en: to write/give/make a precis of a report
ex.cn: 写／提供／做一份报告摘要

example.en: to precis a scientific report
example.cn: 写科研报告摘要

senses.def: clear and accurate
senses.chn: 准确的；确切的；精确的；明确的

ex.en: precise details/instructions/measurements
ex.cn: 确切的细节；明确的指令；精确的尺寸

ex.en: Can you give a more precise definition of the word?
ex.cn: 你能给这个词下个更确切的定义吗？

ex.en: I can be reasonably precise about the time of the incident.
ex.cn: 我可以相当准确地说出这件事发生的时间。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth happens at a particular time or in a particular way

ex.en: We were just talking about her when, at that precise moment, she walked in.
ex.cn: 我们正谈论着她，恰好在这个时候，她走进来了。

ex.en: Doctors found it hard to establish the precise nature of her illness.
ex.cn: 医生们难以判定她的确切病因。

senses.def: taking care to be exact and accurate, especially about small details
senses.chn: 细致的；精细的；认真的；一丝不苟的

ex.en: a skilled and precise worker
ex.cn: 熟练而认真的工人

ex.en: small, precise movements
ex.cn: 细微的动作

ex.en: She's rather prim and precise.
ex.cn: 她拘谨严肃，一丝不苟。

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about sth you have just mentioned

ex.en: The shelf is about a metre long—well, 98cm, to be precise.
ex.cn: 架子长约一米。嗯，精确地说，是 98 厘米。

senses.def: exactly

ex.en: They look precisely the same to me.
ex.cn: 依我看，他们的长相一模一样。

ex.en: That's precisely what I meant.
ex.cn: 那恰恰是我的意思。

ex.en: It's not clear precisely how the accident happened.
ex.cn: 事故究竟是怎么发生的不是很清楚。

ex.en: The meeting starts at 2 o'clock precisely.
ex.cn: 会议在两点整开始。

senses.def: accurately; carefully

ex.en: to describe sth precisely
ex.cn: 精确地描述某事物

ex.en: She pronounced the word very slowly and precisely.
ex.cn: 她缓慢而清晰地读出这个字。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is very true or obvious

ex.en: It's precisely because I care about you that I don't like you staying out late.
ex.cn: 正因为我关心你，我才不要你太晚回家。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you agree with a statement, especially because you think it is obvious or is similar to what you have just said
senses.chn: （加强同意的语气）对，的确如此，一点也不错

ex.en: 'It's not that easy, is it?' 'No, precisely.'
ex.cn: “事情并不那么容易吧？” “对，的确不容易。”

senses.def: used to show that you are giving more detailed and accurate information about sth you have just mentioned
senses.chn: 更确切地说；更严格地说

ex.en: The problem is due to discipline, or, more precisely, the lack of discipline, in schools.
ex.cn: 问题出在纪律上，或者更确切地说，是学校缺乏纪律。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, i.e. they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，即是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Some poems are mnemonics, that is to say, they are designed to help you remember something.
ex.cn: 有些诗歌是记忆代码，就是说，其目的是帮助人们记起某事。

ex.en: Mnemonic poems, that is poems designed to help you remember something, are an excellent way to learn lists.
ex.cn: 记事诗，即帮助人记起事情的诗歌，是记住一系列事物的极佳方式。

ex.en: A limerick's rhyme scheme is A–A–B–B–A. In other words, the first, second, and fifth lines all rhyme with one another, while the third and fourth lines have their own rhyme.
ex.cn: 五行打油诗的韵律是 A-A-B-B-A。就是说，第一行、第二行和第五行押一个韵，而第三行和第四行押另一个韵。

ex.en: In this exercise the reader is encouraged to work out the meaning, or rather the range of meanings, of the poem.
ex.cn: 这个练习鼓励读者弄清这首诗的意思，更确切地说是弄清其几种含意。

senses.def: the quality of being exact, accurate and careful

ex.en: done with mathematical precision
ex.cn: 以数学般的精准完成的

ex.en: Historians can't estimate the date with any (degree of) precision.
ex.cn: 历史学家无法准确估算这个日期。

ex.en: He chose his words with precision.
ex.cn: 他用词确切。

ex.en: precision instruments/tools
ex.cn: 精密仪器／工具

senses.def: to prevent sth from happening or sb from doing sth; to make sth impossible
senses.chn: 使行不通；阻止；妨碍；排除

ex.en: Lack of time precludes any further discussion.
ex.cn: 由于时间不足，不可能深入讨论。

ex.en: My lack of interest in the subject precluded me from gaining much enjoyment out of it.
ex.cn: 由于对这个科目缺乏兴趣，我没有从中获得多少乐趣。

ex.en: His religious beliefs precluded him/his serving in the army.
ex.cn: 他的宗教信仰不允许他服兵役。

example.en: Lack of time precludes any further discussion.
example.cn: 由于时间不足，不可能深入讨论。

example.en: My lack of interest in the subject precluded me from gaining much enjoyment out of it.
example.cn: 由于对这个科目缺乏兴趣，我没有从中获得多少乐趣。

example.en: His religious beliefs precluded him/his serving in the army.
example.cn: 他的宗教信仰不允许他服兵役。

senses.def: having developed particular abilities and ways of behaving at a much younger age than usual

ex.en: a precocious child who started her acting career at the age of 5
ex.cn: 5 岁便开始演艺生涯的超常儿童

ex.en: sexually precocious
ex.cn: 性早熟

ex.en: From an early age she displayed a precocious talent for music.
ex.cn: 她年纪轻轻就表现出不凡的音乐天赋。

senses.def: the knowledge that sth will happen in the future, which sb has because of a dream or a sudden feeling
senses.chn: 预知，早知，先知（由梦境或突如其来的感觉感知到未来会发生的事）

senses.def: connected with N and S America and their cultures before the arrival of Columbus in 1492
senses.chn: 哥伦布到达之前的美洲的；前哥伦布的

senses.def: formed before you have enough information or experience of sth

ex.en: Before I started the job, I had no preconceived notions of what it would be like.
ex.cn: 开始做这工作之前，我并未预想过它的实际情况。

senses.def: an idea or opinion that is formed before you have enough information or experience
senses.chn: 事先形成的观念；先入之见；预想；成见

ex.en: a book that will challenge your preconceptions about rural life
ex.cn: 一本改变你对农村生活成见的书

senses.def: something that must happen or exist before sth else can exist or be done

ex.en: A ceasefire is an essential precondition for negotiation.
ex.cn: 停火是谈判的必要前提。

senses.def: associated with a part of the mind from which memories and thoughts that have not been repressed can be brought to the surface
senses.chn: 前意识的（指能被带到意识区域的未受压抑的记忆和思想）

senses.def: prepared and partly cooked in advance so that it can be quickly heated and eaten later
a person or thing that comes before sb/sth similar and that leads to or influences its development
cut in advance and ready to use
senses.chn: 预先剪切的；经剪切随时可用的

senses.def: to be built or formed, or to happen, at an earlier date than sth else in the past
senses.chn: 早于；先于…建成（或形成、发生等）

ex.en: Few of the town's fine buildings predate the earthquake of 1755.
ex.cn: 该城那些精美的建筑很少是 1755 年大地震前建成的。

senses.def: the act of an animal killing and eating other animals
an animal that kills and eats other animals

ex.en: Some animals have no natural predators.
ex.cn: 有些动物没有天敌。

senses.def: a person or an organization that uses weaker people for their own advantage
senses.chn: 弱肉强食的人（或机构）；剥削者；掠夺者

ex.en: to protect domestic industry from foreign predators
ex.cn: 保护本国工业不受外来剥削

senses.def: living by killing and eating other animals
using weaker people for their own financial or sexual advantage
senses.chn: （在金钱或性关系上）欺负弱小的，压榨他人的

ex.en: a predatory insurance salesman
ex.cn: 用高压手段推销的保险推销员

ex.en: a predatory look
ex.cn: 狞视

senses.def: the fact of a business company selling its goods at such a low price that other companies can no longer compete and have to stop selling similar goods
senses.chn: 掠夺性定价；为挤垮对手的大削价

senses.def: to die before sb

ex.en: His wife predeceased him.
ex.cn: 他的妻子先于他去世。

senses.def: a person who did a job before sb else

ex.en: The new president reversed many of the policies of his predecessor.
ex.cn: 新任总统彻底改变了其前任的许多政策。

senses.def: a thing, such as a machine, that has been followed or replaced by sth else
senses.chn: 原先的东西；被替代的事物

senses.def: the theory or the belief that everything that happens has been decided or planned in advance by God or by fate and that humans cannot change it
already decided or planned by God or by fate
senses.chn: 命中注定的；上天安排的

ex.en: It seems she was predestined to be famous.
ex.cn: 她好像是命中注定要出名似的。

senses.def: to decide sth in advance so that it does not happen by chance

ex.en: The sex of the embryo is predetermined at fertilization.
ex.cn: 胚胎的性别早在受精时就决定了。

senses.def: a word that can be used before a determiner, such as all in all the students or twice in twice the price
senses.chn: 前位限定词，前位限定成分（置于限定词前，如 all the students 中的 all 和 twice the price 中的 twice）

senses.def: a difficult or an unpleasant situation, especially one where it is difficult to know what to do

ex.en: the club's financial predicament
ex.cn: 俱乐部的财政困境

ex.en: I'm in a terrible predicament.
ex.cn: 我的处境十分尴尬。

senses.def: a part of a sentence containing a verb that makes a statement about the subject of the verb, such as went home in John went home.
senses.chn: 谓语（句子成分，对主语加以陈述，如 John went home 中的 went home）

senses.def: to base sth on a particular belief, idea or principle

ex.en: Democracy is predicated upon the rule of law.
ex.cn: 民主是以法治为基础的。

senses.def: to state that sth is true

ex.en: The article predicates that the market collapse was caused by weakness of the dollar.
ex.cn: 这篇文章声言，市场的崩溃是美元疲软造成的。

senses.def: coming after a verb such as be, become, get, seem, look. Many adjectives, for example old can be either predicative as in The man is very old, or attributive as in an old man. Some, like asleep, can only be predicative.
senses.chn: 作表语的，谓语性的（例如 asleep，用于 be、become、get、seem、look 等动词后；与 attributive 相对）

senses.def: to say that sth will happen in the future

ex.en: a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
ex.cn: 预报地震的可靠方法

ex.en: Nobody could predict the outcome.
ex.cn: 谁也无法预料结果如何。

ex.en: It is impossible to predict what will happen.
ex.cn: 预知未来的事是不可能的。

ex.en: She predicted (that) the election result would be close.
ex.cn: 她预言选举结果将很接近。

ex.en: It was predicted that inflation would continue to fall.
ex.cn: 据预报，通货膨胀率将继续下降。

ex.en: The trial is predicted to last for months.
ex.cn: 预料审讯将持续数月之久。

example.en: a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
example.cn: 预报地震的可靠方法

example.en: It is impossible to predict what will happen.
example.cn: 预知未来的事是不可能的。

example.en: She predicted (that) the election result would be close.
example.cn: 她预言选举结果将很接近。

example.en: It was predicted that inflation would continue to fall.
example.cn: 据预报，通货膨胀率将继续下降。

phrases.pattern: sb/sth is predicted to do sth
phrases.filled: sb/sth is predicted to do sth

example.en: The trial is predicted to last for months.
example.cn: 预料审讯将持续数月之久。

senses.def: if sth is predictable, you know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like

ex.en: a predictable result
ex.cn: 可预见的结果

ex.en: The ending of the book was entirely predictable.
ex.cn: 那本书的结局是完全预料得到的。

ex.en: In March and April, the weather is much less predictable.
ex.cn: 三、四月份的天气非常不好预测。

senses.def: behaving or happening in a way that you would expect and therefore boring
senses.chn: 意料之中的；老套乏味的

ex.en: He's very nice, but I find him rather dull and predictable.
ex.cn: 他为人很不错，但我觉得他相当呆板乏味。

senses.def: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement

ex.en: Not many people agree with the government's prediction that the economy will improve.
ex.cn: 没有多少人赞同政府认为经济将会有所改善的预测。

ex.en: The results of the experiment confirmed our predictions.
ex.cn: 实验结果证实了我们的预测。

ex.en: Skilled readers make use of context and prediction.
ex.cn: 阅读能力强的人会利用上下文及推测来理解文意。

ex.en: It's difficult to make accurate predictions about the effects on the environment.
ex.cn: 很难准确预测对环境产生的影响。

ex.en: The number of people using mobile phones to purchase goods and services is expected / likely to more than double by the end of 2015.
ex.cn: 到 2015 年年底，使用手机购买商品和服务的人数预计／可能会是现在的两倍多。

ex.en: Experts have predicted / forecast that the number of people using their mobile phones to pay for goods and services should exceed 190 million in 2015.
ex.cn: 专家已经预言，到 2015 年使用手机支付商品和服务费用的人数将超过 1.9 亿。

senses.def: connected with the ability to show what will happen in the future

ex.en: the predictive power of science
ex.cn: 科学的预测能力

senses.def: allowing you to enter text on a computer or a mobile/cell phone more quickly by using the first few letters of each word to predict what you want to say
senses.chn: 预测输入的（根据输入的字母来预测可能的字词）

ex.en: predictive text input
ex.cn: 预测文字输入

ex.en: predictive messaging
ex.cn: 可预测输入的信息传送

senses.def: something that can show what will happen in the future
senses.chn: 有预测作用的事物；预示物

ex.en: Cholesterol level is not a strong predictor of heart disease in women.
ex.cn: 胆固醇水平在预示女性患心脏病方面并不是一个很准确的因素。

senses.def: put in a simple form that is easy to understand
if you have a predilection for sth, you like it very much
to influence sb so that they are likely to think or behave in a particular way

ex.en: He believes that some people are predisposed to criminal behaviour.
ex.cn: 他认为有些人容易犯罪。

ex.en: Her good mood predisposed her to enjoy the play.
ex.cn: 她当时兴致高，所以一定喜欢那出戏。

senses.def: to make it likely that you will suffer from a particular illness
senses.chn: 使易于患（某种病）；容易诱发

ex.en: Stress can predispose people to heart attacks.
ex.cn: 压力容易使人患心脏病。

example.en: He believes that some people are predisposed to criminal behaviour.
example.cn: 他认为有些人容易犯罪。

example.en: Her good mood predisposed her to enjoy the play.
example.cn: 她当时兴致高，所以一定喜欢那出戏。

senses.def: a condition that makes sb/sth likely to behave in a particular way or to suffer from a particular disease
senses.chn: 倾向；癖性；（易患某种病的）体质

ex.en: a genetic predisposition to liver disease
ex.cn: 易患肝病的遗传体质

senses.def: the situation of being greater in number or amount than other things or people

ex.en: a predominance of female teachers in elementary schools
ex.cn: 小学里女教师居多的现象

senses.def: the state of having more power or influence than others
most obvious or noticeable

ex.en: a predominant feature
ex.cn: 显著特征

ex.en: Yellow is the predominant colour this spring in the fashion world.
ex.cn: 黄色是今春时装界的流行色。

senses.def: having more power or influence than others

ex.en: a predominant culture
ex.cn: 主流文化

senses.def: mostly; mainly

ex.en: She works in a predominantly male environment.
ex.cn: 她在一个男性居多的环境里工作。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

ex.en: Senior management posts are predominantly held by men.
ex.cn: 高层管理职位大多由男性担任。

senses.def: to be greater in amount or number than sth/sb else in a place, group, etc.

ex.en: a colour scheme in which red predominates
ex.cn: 以红色为主的色彩组合

ex.en: Women predominated in the audience.
ex.cn: 观众以妇女为主。

senses.def: to have the most influence or importance
senses.chn: 占主导地位；有最大影响（或重要性）

ex.en: Private interest was not allowed to predominate over the public good.
ex.cn: 私人利益不得凌驾于公众利益之上。

senses.def: a condition in which a pregnant woman has high blood pressure, which can become serious if it is not treated
senses.chn: 先兆子痫，水肿蛋白尿高血压综合征（由怀孕引起）

senses.def: a premature baby
more important, more successful or of a higher standard than others
senses.chn: 杰出的；出类拔萃的；卓越的

ex.en: Dickens was pre-eminent among English writers of his day.
ex.cn: 狄更斯在其同时期英国作家中最为出色。

senses.def: to a very great degree; especially
to prevent sth from happening by taking action to stop it

ex.en: A good training course will pre-empt many problems.
ex.cn: 良好的培训课程会防止许多问题产生。

senses.def: to do or say sth before sb else does
senses.chn: 抢在…之前做（或说）；先发制人

ex.en: She was just about to apologize when he pre-empted her.
ex.cn: 她正想道歉，他却抢先说了。

senses.def: to replace a planned programme on the television
senses.chn: 临时取代（电视节目表上的节目）

ex.en: The scheduled programme will be pre-empted by a special news bulletin.
ex.cn: 预定的节目将临时换成特别新闻简报。

senses.def: the opportunity given to one person or group to buy goods, shares, etc.

ex.en: Existing shareholders will have pre-emption rights.
ex.cn: 现有股东将有优先购买权。

senses.def: done to stop sb taking action, especially action that will be harmful to yourself

ex.en: a pre-emptive attack/strike on the military base
ex.cn: 对军事基地先发制人的进攻

senses.def: to spend a lot of time making yourself look attractive and then admiring your appearance
senses.chn: 刻意打扮，精心修饰（并自我欣赏）

ex.cn: 危难时有她在，对大家的心情有稳定作用。

ex.cn: 务请出席会议。

ex.cn: 这项检查能鉴定胎儿是否有不正常现象。

senses.chn: （派遣的）一个队；（尤指执行任务的）部队

ex.cn: 政府在这地区派驻了大批警察。

ex.cn: 风度翩翩的男子

ex.cn: 本文件是有两位证人见证签署的。

ex.cn: 她要求他们不要当着她的面讨论这个问题。

senses.chn: 镇定；处变不惊；遇事不慌

ex.cn: 那男孩子镇定地关掉了煤气。

ex.cn: 在当前形势下

ex.cn: 现在的房主

ex.cn: 过去和现在的全部会员名单

ex.cn: 目前我们没有进一步的消息。

ex.cn: 大气中的污染程度正在加深。

ex.cn: 分析显示，尸体中有微量砷。

senses.chn: 全到无误；应在场的都在场了

ex.cn: 我给他送点什么生日礼物呢？

ex.cn: 你必须忘掉过去，开始现在的生活。

ex.cn: 很抱歉他这会儿不在。

ex.cn: 这房子现在还够大。要是有了孩子，我们还得搬。

ex.cn: 当地议员将鸣枪开赛，并颁发奖品。

ex.en: On his retirement, colleagues presented him with a set of golf clubs.
ex.cn: 在他退休之际，同事们赠给他一套高尔夫球杆。

ex.en: The sword was presented by the family to the museum.
ex.cn: 这家人把宝剑捐赠给了博物馆。

senses.def: to show or offer sth for other people to look at or consider

ex.cn: 委员会将于六月向议会提交最后的报告。

ex.en: Eight options were presented for consideration.
ex.cn: 已提出八项备选方案供审议。

ex.cn: 你要在大会上宣读论文吗？

ex.cn: 公司已决定，必须展现出更加现代的形象。

ex.en: It is essential that we present a united front (= show that we all agree).
ex.cn: 至关重要的是我们要表现得团结一致。

ex.cn: 你需要更善于展示自己。

ex.cn: 他喜欢表现出一副激进政治家的样子。

ex.cn: 文章认为这些提案失当。

ex.cn: 使用这些化学品有可能导致失火。

ex.cn: 不过，确实出现了一个重大问题。

ex.cn: 一有机会，她就会另谋新职。

ex.cn: 谢天谢地，他意外地很快就找到了答案。

ex.cn: 她曾在电视上主持一个园艺节目。

ex.cn: 罗经剧团推出了全新制作的《李尔王》。

the act of showing sth or of giving sth to sb

ex.en: The trial was adjourned following the presentation of new evidence to the court.
ex.cn: 新证据呈到庭上后，审讯就宣告暂停。

ex.en: The presentation of prizes began after the speeches.
ex.cn: 讲话结束后就开始颁奖了。

ex.en: The Mayor will make the presentation (= hand over the gift) herself.
ex.cn: 市长将亲自颁发礼品。

ex.en: Members will be admitted on presentation of a membership card.
ex.cn: 会员出示会员证便可入场。

senses.def: the way in which sth is offered, shown, explained, etc. to others
senses.chn: 提出（或展示、解释等）的方式

ex.en: Improving the product's presentation (= the way it is wrapped, advertised, etc.) should increase sales.
ex.cn: 改进产品的包装形式会提高销售量。

ex.en: I admire the clear, logical presentation of her arguments.
ex.cn: 我很欣赏她的论证，言辞清晰且有条理。

senses.def: a meeting at which sth, especially a new product or idea, or piece of work, is shown to a group of people

ex.en: The sales manager will give a presentation on the new products.
ex.cn: 营销经理将举行一次新产品推介会。

senses.def: the series of computer slides (= images) that accompany the talk when sb gives a presentation at a meeting

ex.en: I've put my presentation on a memory stick.
ex.cn: 我已经把我的幻灯片演示文件存在 U 盘里了。

senses.def: a ceremony or formal occasion during which a gift or prize is given
a performance of a play, etc. in a theatre
the position in which a baby is lying in the mother's body just before birth
connected with the act of showing, explaining or offering sth to other people, especially a new product, a policy or a performance
senses.chn: 展示的；介绍的；提交的；表演的

ex.en: a course on developing presentational skills
ex.cn: 展示技巧训练课程

senses.def: used after being rude or critical about sb to say that the people you are talking to are not included in the criticism
senses.chn: 在座诸位除外；与这里的各位无关

senses.def: the practice of spending more time at your work than you need to according to your contract
a person who introduces the different sections of a radio or television programme

ex.en: a TV presenter
ex.cn: 电视节目主持人

senses.def: a person who makes a speech or talks to an audience about a particular subject

ex.en: conference presenters
ex.cn: 会议发言人

senses.def: a person who gives sb a prize at a ceremony
a feeling that sth is going to happen, especially sth unpleasant

ex.en: a presentiment of disaster
ex.cn: 大难临头的预感

senses.def: at the time you are speaking or writing; now

ex.en: The crime is presently being investigated by the police.
ex.cn: 警方目前正在调查这起案件。

ex.en: These are the courses presently available.
ex.cn: 这些就是现有的课程。

senses.def: used to show that sth happened after a short time

ex.en: Presently, the door opened again and three men stepped out.
ex.cn: 不久，门又打开了，走出来三个人。

senses.def: used to show that sth will happen soon

ex.en: She'll be here presently.
ex.cn: 她马上就会到这儿。

ex.en: I'll be with you presently.
ex.cn: 我一会儿就来。

ex.en: She is presently living in Milan.
ex.cn: 她现住在米兰。

ex.en: There is presently no cure for the disease.
ex.cn: 目前这种疾病无药可医。

senses.def: the form of the verb that in English ends in -ing and is used with the verb to be to form progressive tenses such as I was running or sometimes as an adjective as in running water
the form of a verb that expresses an action that is happening now or at the time of speaking
the act of keeping sth in its original state or in good condition

ex.en: building/environmental/food preservation
ex.cn: 建筑物的维护；环境保护；食物的保存

ex.en: a preservation group/society
ex.cn: 环保团体

senses.def: the act of making sure that sth is kept

ex.en: The central issue in the strike was the preservation of jobs.
ex.cn: 罢工的核心问题是工作职位的保留。

senses.def: the degree to which sth has not been changed or damaged by age, weather, etc.
senses.chn: 保存的状况；保养的程度

ex.en: The paintings were in an excellent state of preservation.
ex.cn: 这些绘画保存得非常好。

senses.def: a person who works to keep old buildings or areas of the countryside in their original condition and to prevent them from being destroyed
senses.chn: 文物保护者；环境保护者

senses.def: (in Britain) a document that makes it illegal to change or destroy a building, a tree or part of the countryside, because of its beauty or historical interest
a substance used to prevent food or wood from decaying

ex.en: The juice contains no artificial preservatives.
ex.cn: 这种果汁不含人工防腐剂。

ex.en: (a) wood preservative
ex.cn: 木材防腐剂

senses.def: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc.; to make sure that sth is kept

ex.en: He was anxious to preserve his reputation.
ex.cn: 他急于维护自己的名声。

ex.en: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.
ex.cn: 维护和平的努力失败了。

senses.def: to keep sth in its original state in good condition

ex.en: a perfectly preserved 14th century house
ex.cn: 保存完好的 14 世纪宅第

ex.en: Is he really 60? He's remarkably well preserved.
ex.cn: 他真有 60 岁了吗？他真会保养啊。

ex.en: This vase has been preserved intact.
ex.cn: 这个花瓶保存得完好无损。

senses.def: to prevent sth, especially food, from decaying by treating it in a particular way

ex.en: olives preserved in brine
ex.cn: 盐水橄榄

ex.en: Wax polish preserves wood and leather.
ex.cn: 上光蜡可保护木材和皮革。

senses.def: to keep sb/sth alive, or safe from harm or danger

ex.en: The society was set up to preserve endangered species from extinction.
ex.cn: 成立这个协会是为了保护濒危物种不致灭绝。

senses.def: an activity, a job, an interest, etc. that is thought to be suitable for one particular person or group of people
senses.chn: （某人或群体活动、工作等的）专门领域

ex.en: Football is no longer the preserve of men.
ex.cn: 足球再也不是男人的专利了。

ex.en: in the days when nursing was a female preserve
ex.cn: 在护理工作为女性所专有的时代

senses.def: a type of jam made by boiling fruit with a large amount of sugar
a type of pickle made by cooking vegetables with salt or vinegar
an area of private land or water where animals and fish are kept for people to hunt

example.en: a perfectly preserved 14th century house
example.cn: 保存完好的 14 世纪宅第

example.en: This vase has been preserved intact.
example.cn: 这个花瓶保存得完好无损。

senses.def: a person who makes sure that a particular situation does not change

ex.en: The police are the preservers of law and order.
ex.cn: 警察负责维持治安。

senses.def: a substance used to prevent wood from decaying
to set the controls of a piece of electrical equipment so that it will start to work at a particular time

ex.en: You can preset the radiators to come on when you need them to.
ex.cn: 你可以预先调好暖气，使它在你需要的时候启动。

ex.en: to preset TV channels/radio stations (= to set the controls so that particular channels are selected when you press particular buttons)
ex.cn: 预调电视频道／广播电台

senses.def: to decide sth in advance

ex.en: They kept to the preset route.
ex.cn: 他们沿着事先规划的路线前进。

example.en: You can preset the radiators to come on when you need them to.
example.cn: 你可以预先调好暖气，使它在你需要的时候启动。

example.en: to preset TV channels/radio stations (= to set the controls so that particular channels are selected when you press particular buttons)
example.cn: 预调电视频道／广播电台

senses.def: to lead or be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.
senses.chn: 主持（会议、仪式等）；担任（会议）主席

ex.en: the presiding judge
ex.cn: 首席法官

ex.en: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
ex.cn: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

ex.en: The party presided over one of the worst economic declines in the country's history (= it was in power when the decline happened).
ex.cn: 该党执政时期，国家经历了历史上最严重的经济衰退。

example.en: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
example.cn: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

senses.def: the job of being president of a country or an organization; the period of time sb holds this job
senses.chn: 总统（或主席）的职位；总统（或主席）任期

ex.en: the current holder of the EU presidency
ex.cn: 现任欧盟主席

ex.en: He was a White House official during the Bush presidency.
ex.cn: 他是布什任总统时的白宫官员。

senses.def: the leader of a republic, especially the US

ex.en: Several presidents attended the funeral.
ex.cn: 好几位总统参加了葬礼。

ex.en: the President of the United States
ex.cn: 美国总统

ex.en: President Obama is due to visit the country next month.
ex.cn: 奥巴马总统定于下月访问该国。

ex.en: Do you have any comment, Mr President?
ex.cn: 总统先生，您有何评论？

senses.def: the person in charge of some organizations, clubs, colleges, etc.
senses.chn: （机构、俱乐部、学院等的）会长，院长，主席

ex.en: to be made president of the students' union
ex.cn: 当选学生会主席

senses.def: the person in charge of a bank or a commercial organization
senses.chn: 银行行长；总经理；董事长；总裁

ex.en: the bank president
ex.cn: 银行行长

ex.en: the president of Columbia Pictures
ex.cn: 哥伦比亚影业公司董事长

senses.def: a person who has been elected to be president but who has not yet begun the job
(in the US) a legal holiday on the third Monday in February, in memory of the birthdays of George Washington and Abraham Lincoln
senses.chn: 总统日（美国法定假日，二月的第三个星期一，纪念美国总统乔治 · 华盛顿和亚伯拉罕 · 林肯的诞辰）

senses.def: a permanent committee that makes important decisions as part of a government or large political organization, especially in communist countries
senses.chn: （尤指共产主义国家的）常务委员会，主席团

senses.def: newspapers and magazines
senses.chn: 报章杂志；报刊；平面媒体

ex.en: the local/national/foreign press
ex.cn: 地方／全国／外国报刊

ex.en: the popular/tabloid press (= smaller newspapers with a lot of pictures and stories about famous people)
ex.cn: 通俗报刊；小报

ex.en: The story was reported in the press and on television.
ex.cn: 这件事已在报刊和电视上报道了。

ex.en: the music/sporting press (= newspapers and magazines about music/sport)
ex.cn: 音乐／体育报刊

ex.en: Unlike the American, the British press operates on a national scale.
ex.cn: 与美国不同，英国报刊都是行销全国的。

ex.en: the freedom of the Press/press freedom (= the freedom to report any events and express opinions)
ex.cn: 新闻自由

senses.def: the journalists and photographers who work for newspapers and magazines
senses.chn: 记者；新闻工作者；新闻界

ex.en: The Press was/were not allowed to attend the trial.
ex.cn: 庭审谢绝新闻采访。

senses.def: the type or amount of reports that newspapers write about sb/sth

ex.en: The airline has had a bad press recently (= journalists have written unpleasant things about it).
ex.cn: 这家航空公司最近受到新闻界的责难。

senses.def: a machine for printing books, newspapers, etc.; the process of printing them

ex.en: We were able to watch the books rolling off the presses.
ex.cn: 我们可以看到书本从印刷机上源源不断地印出。

ex.en: These prices are correct at the time of going to press.
ex.cn: 这些价格在付印时是准确无误的。

ex.en: a story that is hot off the press (= has just appeared in the newspapers)
ex.cn: 刚刚见报的新闻报道

senses.def: a business that prints and publishes books

ex.en: Oxford University Press
ex.cn: 牛津大学出版社

senses.def: a piece of equipment that is used for creating pressure on things, to make them flat or to get liquid from them

ex.en: a trouser press
ex.cn: 烫裤机

ex.en: a garlic press
ex.cn: 压蒜器

senses.def: an act of pushing sth with your hand or with a tool that you are holding

ex.en: He gave the bell another press.
ex.cn: 他又按了一下铃。

ex.en: Those shirts need a press (= with an iron).
ex.cn: 这些衬衣需要熨一熨。

senses.def: a large number of people or things competing for space or movement
senses.chn: 拥挤的人群（或大批事物）

ex.en: the press of bodies all moving the same way
ex.cn: 拥向同一方向的人群

senses.def: a large cupboard, usually with shelves, for holding clothes, books, etc.
to push sth closely and firmly against sth; to be pushed in this way

ex.en: She pressed her face against the window.
ex.cn: 她把脸贴在窗子上。

ex.en: He pressed a handkerchief to his nose.
ex.cn: 他用手绢捂住鼻子。

ex.en: She pressed her lips together.
ex.cn: 她紧抿着双唇。

ex.en: His body was pressing against hers.
ex.cn: 他的身体紧贴着她。

senses.def: to push or squeeze part of a device, etc. in order to make it work

ex.en: to press a button/switch/key
ex.cn: 按下按钮／开关／按键

ex.en: He pressed the lid firmly shut.
ex.cn: 他把盖子盖得紧紧的。

ex.en: Press here to open.
ex.cn: 请按此处打开。

ex.en: She pressed down hard on the gas pedal.
ex.cn: 她用力踩下油门踏板。

senses.def: to put sth in a place by pushing it firmly

ex.en: He pressed a coin into her hand and moved on.
ex.cn: 他把一枚硬币塞进她手里，然后继续向前走。

senses.def: to squeeze sb's hand or arm, especially as a sign of affection
to move in the direction mentioned by pushing

ex.en: The photographers pressed around the royal visitors.
ex.cn: 摄影记者们在王室贵宾周围挤来挤去。

ex.en: A host of unwelcome thoughts were pressing in on him.
ex.cn: 一大堆恼人的心事涌上他的心头。

senses.def: to make strong efforts to persuade or force sb to do sth

ex.en: If pressed, he will admit that he knew about the affair.
ex.cn: 如果逼问他，他就会承认对此事知情。

ex.en: The bank is pressing us for repayment of the loan.
ex.cn: 银行正在催我们偿还贷款。

ex.en: They are pressing us to make a quick decision.
ex.cn: 他们正催促我们尽快做决定。

ex.en: Don't let yourself be pressed into doing something you don't like.
ex.cn: 不要勉强自己做不喜欢的事情。

senses.def: to express or repeat sth with force

ex.en: I don't want to press the point, but you do owe me $200.
ex.cn: 我不想老提这一点，但你确实欠我 200 美元。

ex.en: She is still pressing her claim for compensation.
ex.cn: 她仍然坚持索赔。

ex.en: They were determined to press their case at the highest level.
ex.cn: 他们决心把事情闹到最高层。

senses.def: to make sth flat or smooth by using force or putting sth heavy on top

ex.en: pressed flowers (= pressed between the pages of a book)
ex.cn: 夹在书页中间压扁的花

ex.en: Press the soil flat with the back of a spade.
ex.cn: 用铁锹背把土拍平。

senses.def: to make clothes smooth using a hot iron

ex.en: My suit needs pressing.
ex.cn: 我的西服该熨了。

senses.def: to squeeze the juice out of fruit or vegetables by using force or weight
to make sth from a material, using pressure

ex.en: to press a CD
ex.cn: 压制一张光盘

ex.en: The car bodies are pressed out of sheets of metal.
ex.cn: 汽车车身是用钣金压制成的。

senses.def: to say hello to people by shaking hands
to get as much advantage as possible from a situation by attacking or arguing in a determined way

ex.en: to press home an attack/an argument/a point
ex.cn: 把进攻／论证／论点坚持到底

ex.en: Simon saw she was hesitating and pressed home his advantage.
ex.cn: 西蒙见她犹豫不决，便趁机占尽优势。

senses.def: to use sb/sth for a purpose that they were not trained or intended for because there is nobody or nothing else available

ex.en: Every type of boat was pressed into service to rescue passengers from the sinking ferry.
ex.cn: 为了营救正在下沉的渡轮上的旅客，各类船只都被临时征用了。

senses.def: to do exactly the right things to please sb
senses.chn: 做得面面俱到以讨好人

ex.en: a new satirical comedy show that pushes all the right buttons
ex.cn: 一出新的极尽搞笑之能事的讽刺喜剧

senses.def: to accuse sb formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court
to react in a sudden or extreme way to sth unexpected that has frightened you
senses.chn: 惊慌失措；仓促行事；采取紧急行动

senses.def: to continue doing sth in a determined way; to hurry forward
senses.chn: 坚决继续进行；匆忙前进；加紧

ex.en: The company is pressing ahead with its plans for a new warehouse.
ex.cn: 这家公司正加紧推动设置新仓库的计划。

ex.en: 'Shall we stay here for the night?' 'No, let's press on.'
ex.cn: “我们今晚在这里住下好吗？” “不，咱们继续走。”

senses.def: to keep asking for sth

ex.en: They continued to press for a change in the law.
ex.cn: 他们不断要求修改这项法律。

senses.def: to try to make sb accept sth, especially food or drink, although they may not want it
senses.chn: 勉强某人接受；强迫某人吃（或喝）

ex.en: She kept pressing cake on us.
ex.cn: 她非要我们吃蛋糕不可。

example.cn: 她把脸贴在窗子上。

example.en: He pressed a handkerchief to his nose.
example.cn: 他用手绢捂住鼻子。

example.en: She pressed her lips together.
example.cn: 她紧抿着双唇。

example.en: His body was pressing against hers.
example.cn: 他的身体紧贴着她。

example.en: to press a button/switch/key
example.cn: 按下按钮／开关／按键

example.en: He pressed the lid firmly shut.
example.cn: 他把盖子盖得紧紧的。

example.en: Press here to open.
example.cn: 请按此处打开。

example.en: If pressed, he will admit that he knew about the affair.
example.cn: 如果逼问他，他就会承认对此事知情。

example.en: The bank is pressing us for repayment of the loan.
example.cn: 银行正在催我们偿还贷款。

example.en: They are pressing us to make a quick decision.
example.cn: 他们正催促我们尽快做决定。

example.cn: 不要勉强自己做不喜欢的事情。

example.en: The car bodies are pressed out of sheets of metal.
example.cn: 汽车车身是用钣金压制成的。

senses.chn: （剧团等雇用的）广告宣传人员

senses.def: a special area or a room at a sports ground where sports journalists sit
senses.chn: （体育场的）新闻工作室，记者席

senses.chn: 记者招待会；新闻发布会

ex.en: to hold/give a press conference
ex.cn: 举行／召开记者招待会

senses.def: a group of journalists who work in or go to a particular place to report on an event
not having enough of sth, especially time or money

ex.en: I'm really pressed for cash at the moment.
ex.cn: 眼下我真的缺钱。

senses.def: made flat using force or a heavy object

ex.en: pictures made with pressed flowers
ex.cn: 用压花制作的画

ex.en: neatly pressed trousers
ex.cn: 熨得平平整整的裤子

senses.def: to keep asking for sth

ex.en: They continued to press for a change in the law.
ex.cn: 他们不断要求修改这项法律。

senses.def: an area in a parliament building or a court for journalists to sit in
a group of people who were employed in the past to force men to join the army or navy
senses.chn: 抓丁团，拉夫队（旧时受雇抓人当兵）

senses.chn: 迫使自己，勉强别人（做某事）

senses.def: needing to be dealt with immediately

ex.en: I'm afraid I have some pressing business to attend to.
ex.cn: 很抱歉，我有些急事需要处理。

senses.def: difficult to refuse or to ignore
senses.chn: 难以推却的；不容忽视的

ex.en: a pressing invitation
ex.cn: 难以推却的邀请

senses.def: an object, especially a record, made by using pressure or weight to shape a piece of metal, plastic, etc.; a number of such objects that are made at one time
senses.chn: 模压制品，同批次的模压产品（尤指唱片）

ex.en: The initial pressing of the group's album has already sold out.
ex.cn: 这个乐队的首批专辑唱片已售罄。

senses.def: a journalist
the office of a large organization, political party or government department that answers questions from journalists and provides them with information
senses.chn: （组织、政党或政府的）新闻办公室

senses.def: a person who is in charge of or works for a press office
senses.chn: 新闻发言人；新闻发布官；新闻局长

senses.def: an official statement made to journalists by a large organization, a political party or a government department
a person who works for a politician or a political organization and gives information about them to journalists, the newspapers, etc.
to get as much advantage as possible from a situation by attacking or arguing in a determined way

ex.cn: 把进攻／论证／论点坚持到底

ex.cn: 西蒙见她犹豫不决，便趁机占尽优势。

ex.cn: 她非要我们吃蛋糕不可。

ex.en: The nurse applied pressure to his arm to stop the bleeding.
ex.cn: 护士压住他的胳膊止血。

ex.cn: 你想洗几套照片？

ex.cn: 一张彩色照片

ex.cn: 这座房子的照片

ex.cn: 我可以拍个照吗？

ex.cn: 我们在旅馆前照了相。

ex.cn: 这篇东西发表的时候，他们将已经离开这个国家了。

printed in a book, newspaper, etc.

ex.cn: 那是他第一次见到自己的名字被刊印出来。

suitable to be repeated in writing and read by people

a machine for printing text on paper, especially one connected to a computer

ex.cn: 彩色／激光打印机

senses.def: a person or a company whose job is printing books, etc.

senses.def: a place where books, etc. are printed
the act of producing letters, pictures, patterns, etc. on sth by pressing a surface covered with ink against it

ex.en: the printing trade
ex.cn: 印刷业

ex.en: colour printing
ex.cn: 彩色印刷

senses.def: the act of printing a number of copies of a book at one time

ex.cn: 这本书是第六次印刷了。

a machine that produces books, newspapers, etc. by pressing a surface covered in ink onto paper
an artist who prints pictures or designs
a system of printing books only when a customer wants one

ex.en: The titles are available through print on demand.
ex.cn: 这些书刊可按需印刷。

ex.en: This is a print-on-demand title.
ex.cn: 这是按需印刷的书。

senses.def: a page or set of pages containing information in printed form from a computer

ex.en: a printout of text downloaded from the Internet
ex.cn: 从互联网下载文本的打印件

senses.def: a list of documents held on a computer that are waiting to be printed
senses.chn: 打印队列，列印佇列（指计算机中等待打印的文件）

senses.def: the number of copies of a book, magazine, etc. printed at one time
senses.chn: （书刊等的）一次印数，每次印数

senses.def: a factory where patterns are printed on cloth

senses.chn: 普里昂，蛋白质感染粒，朊病毒（能导致脑病）

senses.def: happening or existing before sth else or before a particular time

ex.cn: 统计学的知识虽非必要，但最好是学过一点。

ex.en: This information must not be disclosed without prior written consent.
ex.cn: 未事先征得书面许可，此消息不得泄露。

ex.en: Visits are by prior arrangement.
ex.cn: 参观需要事先安排。

ex.en: Please give us prior notice if you need an evening meal.
ex.cn: 需用晚餐者，请预先通知我们。

ex.en: She will be unable to attend because of a prior engagement.
ex.cn: 因事先有别的安排，她将不能出席。

senses.def: already existing and therefore more important
senses.chn: 优先的；占先的；较重要的

ex.cn: 他们有权优先获得该处房产。

ex.cn: 在开会前的一周内

(in an abbey) a person next in rank below an abbot or abbess

ex.cn: 你应该把所有要做的事都列出来，并按轻重缓急排个顺序。

senses.def: to treat sth as being more important than other things

ex.en: The organization was formed to prioritize the needs of older people.
ex.cn: 这个机构是为优先满足老年人的需要而成立的。

senses.def: something that you think is more important than other things and should be dealt with first
senses.chn: 优先事项；最重要的事；首要事情

ex.cn: 重点／非重点项目

ex.cn: 教育是当务之急。

ex.en: Our first priority is to improve standards.
ex.cn: 我们的头等大事是提高标准。

ex.en: Financial security was high on his list of priorities.
ex.cn: 在他的心目中，金融安全是十分重要的一环。

ex.cn: 你需要把自己的事情分出轻重缓急。

ex.cn: 你需要把个人事情的轻重缓急分清楚。

ex.cn: 俱乐部成员享有优先权。

ex.cn: 研制新的疫苗将排在其他一切医学研究之前。

ex.cn: 优先事项，比如无住房家庭的问题，得到优先处理。

senses.def: the right of a vehicle to go before other traffic at a particular place on a road

ex.cn: 在这个路口，公共汽车有优先通行权。

senses.def: a building where a community of monks or nuns lives, which is smaller and less important than an abbey
to use force to separate sth from sth else

ex.en: He prised her fingers from the bag and took it from her.
ex.cn: 他掰开她的手指，把她手中的袋子抢走了。

ex.en: She used a knife to prise open the lid.
ex.cn: 她用刀把盖子撬开了。

senses.def: to force sb to give you information about sb/sth
senses.chn: （向某人）逼问情况；强迫…透露消息

example.en: He prised her fingers from the bag and took it from her.
example.cn: 他掰开她的手指，把她手中的袋子抢走了。

example.en: She used a knife to prise open the lid.
example.cn: 她用刀把盖子撬开了。

senses.def: to force sb to give you information about sb/sth
senses.chn: （向某人）逼问情况；强迫…透露消息

senses.def: a solid figure with ends that are parallel and of the same size and shape, and with sides whose opposite edges are equal and parallel
a transparent glass or plastic object, often with ends in the shape of a triangle, which separates light that passes through it into the colours of the rainbow
using or containing a prism; in the shape of a prism
senses.chn: 用棱柱体（或棱镜）的；棱柱形的

senses.def: formed by a prism; very bright and clear
senses.chn: 棱镜折射的；分光的；绚丽的；五光十色的

senses.def: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime they have committed, or while they are waiting for trial

ex.cn: 他被关押了五年。

ex.cn: 她正在拘押候审中。

ex.en: to be released from prison
ex.cn: 被释放出狱

ex.en: a maximum-security prison
ex.cn: 最高度戒备的监狱

ex.en: the prison population (= the total number of prisoners in a country)
ex.cn: 在押人数

ex.en: the problem of overcrowding in prisons
ex.cn: 监狱人满为患的问题

senses.def: the system of keeping people in prisons

ex.en: the prison service/system
ex.cn: 监狱管理机构／制度

ex.cn: 政府坚持认为 “关押有效”，并计划对暴力犯罪者实行更严厉的判刑政策。

senses.def: a place or situation from which sb cannot escape
senses.chn: 难以脱身的地方（或处境）；牢笼；樊笼

ex.en: His hospital room had become a prison.
ex.cn: 他的病房变成了牢笼。

senses.def: a guarded camp where prisoners, especially prisoners of war or political prisoners, are kept
a person who is kept in prison as a punishment, or while they are waiting for trial

ex.en: The number of prisoners serving life sentences has fallen.
ex.cn: 被判无期徒刑的囚犯数目下降了。

ex.en: They are demanding the release of all political prisoners.
ex.cn: 他们正在要求释放所有的政治犯。

senses.chn: 被（敌人等）关起来的人；俘虏；战俘

ex.cn: 他被叛军俘虏了。

ex.cn: 他们把她劫持了，并索要巨额赎金。

ex.en: She is afraid to go out and has become a virtual prisoner in her own home.
ex.cn: 她不敢出门，实际上已成了关在家中的囚犯。

senses.def: a person who is kept in prison because of his or her political or religious beliefs
senses.chn: （因政治或宗教信仰）被关押的人；政治犯；宗教犯

(in Britain) a person who visits people in prison in order to help them, and who does not get paid for doing so
too careful to always behave correctly and appearing easily shocked by rude behaviour, etc.
senses.chn: 谨小慎微的；大惊小怪的；拘泥谨慎的

senses.def: fresh and clean, as if new

ex.en: The car is in pristine condition.
ex.cn: 这辆汽车是全新的。

senses.def: not developed or changed in any way; left in its original condition
senses.chn: 未开发的；处于原始状态的

ex.en: pristine, pollution-free beaches
ex.cn: 没有污染的原始海滩

senses.def: used when asking sb politely to do sth
the state of being alone and not watched or disturbed by other people

ex.cn: 她渴望过清静的私人生活。

ex.en: I value my privacy.
ex.cn: 我重视自己的隐私。

ex.en: He read the letter later in the privacy of his own room.
ex.cn: 稍后，他在自己房间里私下读了那封信。

senses.def: the state of being free from the attention of the public

ex.en: freedom of speech and the right to privacy
ex.cn: 言论自由与隐私权

senses.def: belonging to or for the use of a particular person or group; not for public use

ex.en: The sign said, 'Private property. Keep out.'
ex.cn: 标牌上写着：“私人领地，禁止进入。”

ex.en: Those are my father's private papers.
ex.cn: 那些都是我父亲的私人文件。

ex.en: The hotel has 110 bedrooms, all with private bathrooms.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆有 110 间客房，各有独立卫生间。

senses.def: intended for or involving a particular person or group of people, not for people in general or for others to know about
senses.chn: 为一部分人的；私人的；秘密的

ex.cn: 私人交谈

ex.en: They were sharing a private joke.
ex.cn: 他们讲着外人听不懂的笑话。

ex.en: Senior defence officials held private talks.
ex.cn: 高级防务官员举行了秘密会谈。

senses.def: that you do not want other people to know about

ex.cn: 她私下的想法和感情

senses.def: owned or managed by an individual person or an independent company rather than by the state

ex.cn: 私营银行

ex.cn: 把众多国营公司转为民营的计划

senses.chn: 个体的，独立的，私人的（尤指医疗或教育）

ex.en: private doctors
ex.cn: 私人医生

ex.en: If I can afford it, I think I'll go private (= pay for medical care rather than use the government service).
ex.cn: 如果负担得起，我想我会自费医疗的。

senses.def: not connected with your work or official position
senses.chn: 与工作（或官职）无关的；个人的；私人的

ex.en: a politician's private life
ex.cn: 政界人物的私生活

ex.en: Let's go somewhere a bit more private.
ex.cn: 咱们另找个僻静些的地方吧。

senses.def: not wanting to share thoughts and feelings with other people
senses.chn: 不愿吐露心思的；内向的；不爱交流思想感情的

ex.cn: 他是个闷葫芦。

senses.def: given by a teacher, etc. to one person or a small group of people for payment
senses.chn: 私人教授的；个别传授的

ex.cn: 她周末做私人英语家教。

senses.chn: 由财产增溢的；间接收入的；非劳动所得的

ex.cn: 他有一笔私人收入。

senses.chn: 二等兵，列兵（级别最低的士兵）

ex.en: Private (John) Smith
ex.cn: 列兵（约翰 ·）史密斯

senses.def: with nobody else present

ex.en: Is there somewhere we can discuss this in private?
ex.cn: 有没有什么地方能让我们单独谈谈这件事？

senses.def: a business that may not offer its shares for sale to the public
senses.chn: 私营公司；私人持股公司

senses.def: a detective who is not in the police, but who can be employed to find out information, find a missing person, follow sb, etc.
the economic system in which industry or business is owned by independent companies or private people and is not controlled by the government
investment made in a company, usually a small one, whose shares are not bought and sold by the public
senses.chn: （通常指小公司的）私募股权，私人权益资本，私人股权投资

senses.chn: 武装民船，私掠船（旧时用以攻击和劫掠其他船只）

senses.chn: 私法（涉及个人权益、财产等）

senses.def: (in the British political system) a member of parliament who is not a minister in the government
senses.chn: 普通议员（英国议会中不担任政府部长职位的议员）

senses.chn: 自费病人（不受英国国民医疗服务体系补助者）

ex.cn: 英格兰和威尔士的大多数律师都是私人执业者。

senses.def: (in Britain) the fact of providing medical care outside the National Health Service, which people must pay for; a place providing this care
senses.chn: 私人医生开业，私营医疗院所（不属于英国国民医疗服务体系）

senses.def: a school that receives no money from the government and where the education of the students is paid for by their parents
a secretary whose job is to deal with the more important and personal affairs of a business person
a civil servant who acts as an assistant to a senior government official
a soldier of the lowest rank
an occasion when a few people are invited to look at an exhibition of paintings before it is open to the public
senses.chn: （局限于少数参观者的）画作预展

senses.def: a lack of the basic things that people need for living

ex.en: the privations of poverty
ex.cn: 艰难困苦

ex.en: They endured years of suffering and privation.
ex.cn: 他们饱受多年的煎熬与贫困。

senses.def: to sell a business or an industry so that it is no longer owned by the government
a bush with small dark green leaves that remain on the bush and stay green all year, often used for garden hedges
senses.chn: 女贞（常绿灌木，常用作花园绿篱）

ex.en: a privet hedge
ex.cn: 女贞树篱

senses.def: a special right or advantage that a particular person or group of people has

ex.en: Education should be a universal right and not a privilege.
ex.cn: 教育应当是全民共有的而非少数人独享的权利。

ex.en: You can enjoy all the benefits and privileges of club membership.
ex.cn: 你可以享受俱乐部成员的一切福利和优惠。

senses.def: the rights and advantages that rich and powerful people in a society have
senses.chn: （有钱有势者的）特权，特殊待遇

ex.en: As a member of the nobility, his life had been one of wealth and privilege.
ex.cn: 身为贵族中的一员，他过着有钱有势的生活。

senses.def: something that you are proud and lucky to have the opportunity to do

ex.en: I hope to have the privilege of working with them again.
ex.cn: 但愿有幸与他们再度合作。

ex.en: It was a great privilege to hear her sing.
ex.cn: 听她唱歌真是三生有幸。

ex.en: the pleasures and pains of everyday life
ex.cn: 日常生活的苦与乐

ex.en: It's been a pleasure meeting you.
ex.cn: 很高兴认识您。

ex.en: the delights of living in the country
ex.cn: 生活在乡村的乐趣

ex.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
ex.cn: 童年的欢乐与悲伤

senses.def: a special right to do or say things without being punished

ex.en: parliamentary privilege (= the special right of members of parliament to say particular things without risking legal action)
ex.cn: 议会言论免责权

senses.def: to give sb/sth special rights or advantages that others do not have

ex.en: education policies that privilege the children of wealthy parents
ex.cn: 特别优遇富家子弟的教育政策

senses.def: having special rights or advantages that most people do not have
senses.chn: 有特权的；受特别优待的

ex.cn: 过去，当权者自有特权。

ex.cn: 她出身特权阶层。

ex.en: In those days, only a privileged few had the vote.
ex.cn: 在那个时代，只有少数特殊的人才享有选举权。

senses.def: having an opportunity to do sth that makes you feel proud

ex.en: We are privileged to welcome you as our speaker this evening.
ex.cn: 我们荣幸地欢迎您今晚来讲演。

senses.def: known only to a few people and legally protected so that it does not have to be made public
allowed to know about sth secret

ex.en: She was not privy to any information contained in the letters.
ex.cn: 她未获准接触那些信的内容。

senses.def: a toilet, especially an outdoor one
an award that is given to a person who wins a competition, race, etc. or who does very good work

ex.en: She was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
ex.cn: 她获颁诺贝尔和平奖。

ex.en: He won first prize in the woodwind section.
ex.cn: 他获得木管乐器组一等奖。

ex.en: There are no prizes for guessing (= it is very easy to guess) who she was with.
ex.cn: 一下子就能猜出她和谁在一起了。

ex.en: I won £500 in prize money.
ex.cn: 我获得了 500 英镑的奖金。

ex.en: Win a car in our grand prize draw!
ex.cn: 参加我们的大抽奖，赢取一辆汽车！

senses.def: something very important or valuable that is difficult to achieve or obtain
senses.chn: 难能可贵的事物；难以争取的重要事物

ex.cn: 世界和平是最可贵的。

senses.def: good enough to win a prize in a competition
senses.chn: 好得足以得奖的；应获奖的

ex.en: prize cattle
ex.cn: 能获奖的牛

senses.def: being a very good example of its kind
senses.chn: 优秀的；典范性的；出类拔萃的

ex.en: a prize student
ex.cn: 模范学生

ex.en: He's a prize specimen of the human race!
ex.cn: 他是人中楷模！

ex.en: She's a prize idiot (= very silly).
ex.cn: 她是十足的蠢猪。

senses.def: to value sth highly

ex.en: an era when honesty was prized above all other virtues
ex.cn: 尊诚实为美德之首的时代

ex.en: Oil of cedarwood is highly prized for its use in perfumery.
ex.cn: 雪松油可用于制香水，因此十分珍贵。

example.en: an era when honesty was prized above all other virtues
example.cn: 尊诚实为美德之首的时代

example.en: Oil of cedarwood is highly prized for its use in perfumery.
example.cn: 雪松油可用于制香水，因此十分珍贵。

senses.def: very valuable to sb

ex.en: I lost some of my most prized possessions in the fire.
ex.cn: 大火吞噬了我的一些最珍贵的物品。

senses.def: a boxing competition that is fought for money
a ceremony at which prizes are given to people who have done very good work
a person who has won a prize
a person who works as a professional, especially in a sport
senses.chn: 从事某职业的人；职业运动员；职业选手；老手

ex.en: a golf pro
ex.cn: 职业高尔夫球选手

ex.en: He handled the situation like an old pro (= sb who has a lot of experience).
ex.cn: 他像行家一般处理了这一局面。

senses.def: the advantages and disadvantages of sth
senses.chn: 事物的利与弊；支持与反对

ex.cn: 我们权衡了利弊得失。

senses.def: professional

ex.en: a pro wrestler
ex.cn: 职业摔跤手

ex.en: pro football

ex.en: Sophie became public property when she married into the royal family.
ex.cn: 索菲嫁入王室后，即成为公众人物。

senses.def: a lawyer who works for the government and tries to prove people guilty in court
the business of giving the public information about a particular organization or person in order to create a good impression

ex.en: She works in public relations.
ex.cn: 她从事公关工作。

ex.en: a public relations exercise
ex.cn: 一项公关活动

senses.def: the state of the relationship between an organization and the public

ex.en: Sponsoring the local team is good for public relations.
ex.cn: 赞助当地球队有利于公共关系。

senses.chn: 公学（在英国，尤其是英格兰，为 13 到 18 岁青少年开办的私立付费学校，学生常寄宿）

ex.cn: 他出身英国公学。

senses.def: (in the US, Australia, Scotland and other countries) a free local school paid for by the government
senses.chn: （美国、澳大利亚、苏格兰及其他国家免费的）公立学校

senses.def: a person who is employed by the state or in local government or who is an elected representative

ex.en: pay increases for public servants
ex.cn: 公务员的加薪

ex.en: a long and outstanding career as a public servant
ex.cn: 任公务员时间长且表现优秀

senses.def: a service such as transport or health care that a government or an official organization provides for people in general in a particular society

ex.en: to improve public services in the area
ex.cn: 改进本地区的公用事业

ex.en: a public service broadcast
ex.cn: 公营广播

senses.def: something that is done to help people rather than to make a profit

ex.en: to perform a public service
ex.cn: 从事一项公益服务

senses.def: the government and government departments

ex.cn: 在政府机关工作

ex.en: public service workers
ex.cn: 公务人员

senses.def: radio and television programmes broadcast by organizations such as the BBC in Britain that are independent of government but are financed by public money
senses.chn: 公共服务广播（由英国广播公司等受公款资助的非政府独立机构播放的节目）

senses.def: willing to do things that will help other people in society
senses.chn: 有公益精神的；热心公益的；助人为乐的

ex.en: a public-spirited act
ex.cn: 助人为乐的行为

ex.cn: 你那样做真是热心公益啊！

senses.def: a television service that shows mainly educational programmes and is paid for by the government, the public and some companies
senses.chn: 大众文化教育电视（由政府、公众以及某些公司赞助）

senses.def: the system of buses, trains, etc. provided by the government or by companies, which people use to travel from one place to another

ex.en: to travel on/by public transport
ex.cn: 乘公交车

ex.en: Most of us use public transport to get to work.
ex.cn: 我们大多数人都乘公共交通工具上班。

senses.def: a private company that must obey government rules, that supplies essential services such as gas, water and electricity to the public
building work, such as that of hospitals, schools and roads, that is paid for by the government
to produce a book, magazine, CD-ROM, etc. and sell it to the public

ex.en: The first edition was published in 2007.
ex.cn: 第一版于 2007 年发行。

ex.en: He works for a company that publishes reference books.
ex.cn: 他在一家工具书出版公司工作。

ex.en: Most of our titles are also published on CD-ROM.
ex.cn: 我们的大部分书籍也制成光盘发行。

senses.def: to print a letter, an article, etc. in a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: Pictures of the suspect were published in all the daily papers.
ex.cn: 嫌疑人的照片刊登在各家日报上了。

senses.def: to make sth available to the public on the Internet

ex.en: The report will be published on the Internet.
ex.cn: 报告将在互联网上公布。

senses.def: to have your work printed and sold to the public

ex.en: She hasn't published anything for years.
ex.cn: 她好几年没有发表作品了。

ex.en: University teachers are under pressure to publish.
ex.cn: 大学教师有不得不发表作品的压力。

senses.def: to make official information known to the public

ex.en: The findings of the committee will be published on Friday.
ex.cn: 委员会的调查结果将于星期五公布。

senses.def: a person or company that prepares and prints books, magazines, newspapers or electronic products and makes them available to the public
senses.chn: 出版人（或机构）；发行人（或机构）

senses.def: the profession or business of preparing and printing books, magazines, CD-ROMs, etc. and selling or making them available to the public

ex.en: a publishing house (= company)
ex.cn: 出版社

senses.def: reddish-purple in colour

ex.en: His face was puce with rage.
ex.cn: 他气得脸色发紫。

senses.def: a hard flat rubber disc that is used as a ball in ice hockey
a pointing device that looks like a computer mouse and is used to control the movement of the cursor on a computer screen
senses.chn: 手持游标器；光标定位器；定标器

senses.def: to form or to make sth form small folds or lines

ex.en: His face puckered, and he was ready to cry.
ex.cn: 他的脸一皱，像要哭了。

ex.en: She puckered her lips.
ex.cn: 她噘起嘴唇。

ex.en: puckered fabric
ex.cn: 有褶皱的织物

senses.def: enjoying playing tricks on other people
senses.chn: 顽皮的；淘气的；爱恶作剧的

senses.def: a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal

ex.en: What's for pudding?
ex.cn: 有什么甜点？

ex.cn: 我今天没做甜点。

senses.def: a hot sweet dish, often like a cake, made from flour, fat and eggs with fruit, jam, etc. in or on it
senses.chn: 热布丁糕（用面粉、油、蛋制作，加水果、果酱等）

ex.en: treacle pudding
ex.cn: 糖浆布丁

ex.en: bread and butter pudding (= made with bread, butter and milk)
ex.cn: 面包黄油布丁

senses.def: a hot dish like a pie with soft pastry made from flour, fat and eggs and usually filled with meat
senses.chn: 热布丁饼（用面粉、油、蛋制作，通常用肉填充）

ex.en: a steak and kidney pudding
ex.cn: 牛肉腰子布丁

senses.def: a cold dessert (= a sweet dish) like cream flavoured with fruit, chocolate, etc.
senses.chn: 冷布丁（有水果、巧克力等口味）

ex.en: chocolate pudding
ex.cn: 巧克力布丁

senses.def: used to say that you think sb has done more than is necessary, or has added unnecessary details to make sth seem better or worse than it really is

ex.en: If you're telling lies, keep it simple—never over-egg the pudding.
ex.cn: 如果撒谎，措辞要简短，千万别画蛇添足。

senses.def: you can only judge if sth is good or bad when you have tried it
senses.chn: 只有通过体验才能判断事物的好坏

senses.chn: 水洼；小水坑；（尤指）雨水坑

slightly fat

senses.chn: 愚蠢的；幼稚的；孩子气的

ex.cn: 他（一口一口地）吸着烟斗。

ex.en: I sat puffing my cigar.
ex.cn: 我坐着抽雪茄。

senses.def: to make smoke or steam blow out in clouds; to blow out in clouds

ex.en: Chimneys were puffing out clouds of smoke.
ex.cn: 烟囱冒着滚滚浓烟。

ex.en: Steam puffed out.
ex.cn: 蒸汽向外喷出。

ex.en: I was starting to puff a little from the climb.
ex.cn: 爬坡弄得我有点喘息起来。

ex.en: The train puffed into the station.
ex.cn: 火车喷着蒸汽驶进车站。

to breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth after physical effort
senses.chn: 气喘吁吁；呼哧呼哧地喘

senses.def: to breathe in a noisy way because you are very tired
senses.chn: 气喘吁吁；上气不接下气

ex.en: Jack was huffing and puffing to keep up with her.
ex.cn: 杰克气喘吁吁地跟着她。

senses.def: to make it obvious that you are annoyed about sth without doing anything to change the situation
senses.chn: 发脾气；愤然不理；生闷气；气呼呼

ex.en: After much huffing and puffing, she finally agreed to help.
ex.cn: 她生了好一阵闷气之后才终于同意帮忙。

ex.en: She puffed out her cheeks.
ex.cn: 她鼓起了腮帮子。

ex.en: Her cheeks puffed up.
ex.cn: 她的腮帮子鼓了起来。

ex.en: The frog puffed itself up.
ex.cn: 这只青蛙胀得鼓鼓的。

senses.def: an act of breathing in sth such as smoke from a cigarette, or drugs
senses.chn: 吸，抽（把气体经口或鼻引到体内的动作）

ex.en: He had a few puffs at the cigar.
ex.cn: 他吸了几口雪茄。

ex.en: Take two puffs from the inhaler every four hours.
ex.cn: 每隔四小时从吸药器中吸两口药。

senses.def: a small amount of air, smoke, etc. that is blown from somewhere

ex.en: a puff of wind
ex.cn: 一丝清风

ex.en: Puffs of white smoke came from the chimney.
ex.cn: 烟囱冒出了袅袅白烟。

ex.en: Any chance of success seemed to vanish in a puff of smoke (= to disappear quickly).
ex.cn: 成功的机会犹如一缕青烟，瞬息即逝。

senses.def: a hollow piece of light pastry that is filled with cream, jam, etc.
a piece of writing or speech that praises sb/sth too much
breath

ex.cn: 山坡陡峭，我很快就气喘吁吁了。

example.en: He puffed (away) on his pipe.
example.cn: 他（一口一口地）吸着烟斗。

example.en: I sat puffing my cigar.
example.cn: 我坐着抽雪茄。

example.en: Chimneys were puffing out clouds of smoke.
example.cn: 烟囱冒着滚滚浓烟。

example.en: Steam puffed out.
example.cn: 蒸汽向外喷出。

senses.def: to breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth after physical effort
senses.chn: 气喘吁吁；呼哧呼哧地喘

senses.def: a fungus with a round brown head, that bursts when it is ready to release its seeds
breathing quickly and with difficulty because you have been having a lot of physical exercise
senses.chn: 气喘吁吁；上气不接下气

senses.def: a poisonous fish that lives in warm seas and fills with air when it is in danger
a black and white bird with a large, brightly coloured beak that lives near the sea, common in the N Atlantic
senses.chn: 角嘴海雀，海鹦（常见于北大西洋，喙大而色艳）

a type of sleeve on a piece of clothing that fits close to the body at the shoulder and the lower edge and is wider in the middle, forming a round shape
to swell or to make sth swell

ex.en: Her cheeks puffed up.
ex.cn: 她的腮帮子鼓了起来。

ex.en: The frog puffed itself up.
ex.cn: 这只青蛙胀得鼓鼓的。

senses.def: looking swollen (= larger, rounder, etc. than usual)

ex.en: Her eyes were puffy from crying.
ex.cn: 她眼睛都哭肿了。

senses.def: looking soft, round and white
senses.chn: 松软洁白的；白绒团状的

senses.def: a small dog with short hair and a wide flat face with deep folds of skin
a boxer
having a strong desire to argue or fight with other people
senses.chn: 爱争执的；好斗的；爱滋事的

senses.def: a competition in showjumping to test a horse's ability to jump high fences
great power or influence
a Hindu ceremony of worship
an offering (= a gift that is given to a god) at the ceremony
senses.chn: 普阇祭品；印度教礼拜祭品

senses.def: a Hindu priest
to vomit

ex.en: The baby puked all over me this morning.
ex.cn: 宝宝今天早上吐了我一身。

ex.en: That guy makes me puke!(= makes me angry)
ex.cn: 那个家伙气死我了！

ex.en: I puked up my dinner.
ex.cn: 我把吃的饭都吐了。

senses.def: genuine; not a copy; appropriate in a particular social situation
senses.chn: 真品的；适用于社交场合的

senses.def: of very good quality
senses.chn: 高质量的；上等的；一流的

senses.def: beauty
in the US, one of the prizes that are given each year for excellent work in literature, music, or journalism
senses.chn: 普利策奖（美国年度奖，颁发给文学、音乐或新闻业优秀作品的奖项之一）

senses.def: to hold sth firmly and use force in order to move it or try to move it towards yourself

ex.en: You push and I'll pull.
ex.cn: 你推，我拉。
